title: 第八章 拉普拉斯变换
text:
拉普拉斯逆变换
回忆拉普拉斯变换与连续时间傅里叶变换的关系：
\[
X(\sigma + j\omega) = \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} \{x(t) e^{-\sigma t}\} e^{-j\omega t} \, dt = \mathcal{F}\{x(t) e^{-\sigma t}\}
\]
对 \(s=\sigma + j\omega \in \mathrm{ROC}\) 取傅里叶逆变换：
\[
x(t) e^{-\sigma t} = \frac{1}{2\pi} \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} X(\sigma + j\omega) e^{j\omega t} \, d\omega
\]
因此
\[
x(t) = \frac{1}{2\pi} \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} X(\sigma + j\omega) e^{(\sigma + j\omega) t} \, d\omega
\]
或
\[
x(t) = \frac{1}{j 2\pi} \int_{\sigma - j\infty}^{\sigma + j\infty} X(s) e^{s t} \, ds = \lim_{A\to\infty} \frac{1}{j 2\pi} \int_{\sigma - j A}^{\sigma + j A} X(s) e^{s t} \, ds
\]

objectID: Chapter08_V3.html#部分分式展开求逆变换
href: Chapter08_V3.html#部分分式展开求逆变换
title: 第八章 拉普拉斯变换
section: 部分分式展开求逆变换
text:
部分分式展开求逆变换
对于有理拉普拉斯变换，可通过部分分式展开求逆变换。
一个严格真有理函数的部分分式展开形式为
\[
R(s) = \sum_{i=1}^{r} \sum_{k_{i}=1}^{N_{i}} \frac{A_{i,k_{i}}}{(s + a_{i})^{k_{i}}}
\]
同时
\[
\begin{aligned}
\frac{t^{n-1}}{(n-1)!} e^{-a t} u(t) &\stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{1}{(s+a)^{n}}, && \operatorname{Re} s > -a \\
-\frac{t^{n-1}}{(n-1)!} e^{-a t} u(-t) &\stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{1}{(s+a)^{n}}, && \operatorname{Re} s < -a
\end{aligned}
\]
由线性性质，\(\mathcal{L}^{-1}\{R\}\) 是上述形式各项的线性组合，符号根据 ROC 选取。

title: 第八章 拉普拉斯变换
text:
例
考虑有理拉普拉斯变换 \(X(s)=\frac{1}{(s+1)(s+2)^{2}}\)
\[
X(s) = \frac{1}{s+1} + \frac{-1}{s+2} + \frac{-1}{(s+2)^{2}}
\]
极点位于 \(s=-1\) 和 \(s=-2\)。

若 ROC 为 \(\operatorname{Re} s > -1\)

\[
x(t) = e^{-t} u(t) - (1+t) e^{-2t} u(t)
\]

若 ROC 为 \(\operatorname{Re} s < -2\)

\[
x(t) = -e^{-t} u(-t) + (1+t) e^{-2t} u(-t)
\]

若 ROC 为 \(-2 < \operatorname{Re} s < -1\)

\[
x(t) = -e^{-t} u(-t) - (1+t) e^{-2t} u(t)
\]

title: 第八章 拉普拉斯变换
text:
围线积分求逆变换
假设 \(X(s)\) 有有限个有限孤立奇点 \(s_{1},\dots,s_{n}\)，且 ROC 为 \(-\infty \leq \sigma_{1} < \operatorname{Re} s < \sigma_{2} \leq +\infty\)。
逆变换为
\[
x(t) = \lim_{r\to\infty} \frac{1}{j 2\pi} \int_{\sigma - j r}^{\sigma + j r} X(s) e^{s t} \, ds
\]


其中 \(\sigma_{1} < \sigma < \sigma_{2}\)。
对于 \(t>0\)，选取一个包含所有 \(\operatorname{Re} s \leq \sigma_{1}\) 的奇点 \(s_{k}\) 的大半圆 \(C_{r}\)。
若 \(X(s)\) 满足 Jordan 引理，由留数定理得
\[
x(t) = \sum_{k: \operatorname{Re} s_{k} \leq \sigma_{1}} \operatorname{Res}[X(s) e^{s t}, s_{k}], \quad t>0
\]
（对严格真有理函数成立）

title: 第八章 拉普拉斯变换
text:
围线积分求逆变换
对于 \(t<0\)，选取包含所有 \(\operatorname{Re} s \geq \sigma_{2}\) 的奇点的大半圆。


由留数定理得
\[
x(t) = -\sum_{k: \operatorname{Re} s_{k} \geq \sigma_{2}} \operatorname{Res}[X(s) e^{s t}, s_{k}], \quad t<0
\] 注意：负号源于围线的负方向。

title: 第八章 拉普拉斯变换
text:
例
考虑 \(X(s)=\frac{1}{(s+1)(s+2)^{2}}\)
\[
\begin{gathered}
\operatorname{Res}[X(s) e^{s t}, -1] = \left.\frac{e^{s t}}{(s+2)^{2}}\right|_{s=-1} = e^{-t} \\
\operatorname{Res}[X(s) e^{s t}, -2] = \left[\frac{d}{ds} \frac{e^{s t}}{s+1}\right]_{s=-2} = -(1+t) e^{-2t}
\end{gathered}
\]

若 ROC 为 \(\operatorname{Re} s > -1\)，则 \(\sigma_{1}=-1\)，\(\sigma_{2}=+\infty\)。

\(t>0\) 时：
\[
x(t) = e^{-t} - (1+t) e^{-2t}
\]
\(t<0\) 时：
\[
x(t) = 0
\]

text:
奇异函数的拉普拉斯变换
之前讨论的拉普拉斯变换性质对这一推广仍然成立。
例 时域微分性质等价于包含 \(\delta'\) 的卷积性质：
\[
\mathcal{L}\{x'\} = \mathcal{L}\{x * \delta'\} = \mathcal{L}\{x\} \mathcal{L}\{\delta'\} = s \mathcal{L}\{x\}
\]
例
  
\(X_{2}(s) = -\frac{4}{T} + \frac{2}{T} e^{-s \frac{T}{2}} + \frac{2}{T} e^{s \frac{T}{2}} = \frac{8}{T} \sinh^{2}\left(\frac{s T}{4}\right) \Longrightarrow X(s) = \frac{X_{2}(s)}{s^{2}}\)

title: 第八章 拉普拉斯变换
section: 拉普拉斯逆变换（含多项式部分）
text:
拉普拉斯逆变换（含多项式部分）
有理函数可写成一个多项式与严格真有理函数之和：
\[
R(s) = \sum_{k=1}^{n} a_{k} s^{k} + R_{1}(s)
\]
因此
\[
\mathcal{L}^{-1}\{R\} = \sum_{k=1}^{n} a_{k} \delta^{(k)}(t) + \mathcal{L}^{-1}\{R_{1}\}
\]
其中 \(\mathcal{L}^{-1}\{R_{1}\}\) 可通过部分分式展开或围线积分求得。
例 \(X(s)=\frac{s(s+2)}{s+3} = s - 1 + \frac{3}{s+3}\)，ROC \(\operatorname{Re} s > -3\)，故
\[
x(t) = \delta'(t) - \delta(t) + 3 e^{-3t} u(t)
\]

title: 第八章 拉普拉斯变换
text:
连续时间系统函数
回忆连续时间 LTI 系统对输入 \(x(t)\) 的响应为
\[
y(t) = (x * h)(t)
\]
其中 \(h\) 是冲激响应。
若 \(x\) 和 \(h\) 存在拉普拉斯变换，由卷积性质得
\[
Y(s) = X(s) H(s)
\]
在其公共 ROC 内（实际为 ROAC）。
若 ROC 有非空内点，系统函数（也称传递函数）\(H(s)\) 通过拉普拉斯逆变换唯一确定 \(h(t)\)，进而确定系统性质。

title: 第八章 拉普拉斯变换
text:
因果性
回忆 \(h\) 是右边信号当且仅当 \(H(s)\) 的 ROC 是右半平面。
因果 \(\Longrightarrow\) ROC 是右半平面
注意：逆命题不成立。
例 考虑 \(H(s)=\frac{e^{s}}{s+1}\)，ROC \(\operatorname{Re} s > -1\)。由时移性质，
\[
h(t) = e^{-(t+1)} u(t+1)
\]
该系统不是因果的。

title: 第八章 拉普拉斯变换
text:
因果性
对于有理系统函数 \(H(s)\) 的 LTI 系统，因果的充要条件是：ROC 是最右侧极点右侧的右半平面。
证明 对有理系统函数，
\[
H(s) = \sum_{k=1}^{n} a_{k} s^{k} + \sum_{i=1}^{r} \sum_{k_{i}=1}^{N_{i}} \frac{A_{i,k_{i}}}{(s+a_{i})^{k_{i}}}, \quad \operatorname{Re} s > \max_{i} \operatorname{Re}(-a_{i})
\]
于是
\[
h(t) = \sum_{k=1}^{n} a_{k} \delta^{(k)}(t) + \sum_{i=1}^{r} \sum_{k_{i}=1}^{N_{i}} \frac{A_{i,k_{i}}}{(k_{i}-1)!} t^{k_{i}-1} e^{-a_{i} t} u(t)
\]
这是因果的。（也可由围线积分证明）
例如 \(h(t)=e^{-t} u(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{1}{s+1}\)，ROC \(\operatorname{Re} s > -1\)，因果。
例如 \(h(t)=e^{-|t|} \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{-2}{s^{2}-1}\)，ROC \(-1 < \operatorname{Re} s < 1\)，非因果。

title: 第八章 拉普拉斯变换
text:
稳定性
LTI 系统稳定当且仅当其冲激响应 \(h \in L_{1}\)，即
\[
\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} |h(t)| \, dt < \infty
\]
这等价于 \(H(s)\) 在虚轴 \(\operatorname{Re} s=0\) 上绝对收敛，因此其 ROC 必须满足 \(\sigma_{1} < 0 < \sigma_{2}\)。
稳定 \(\Longleftrightarrow\) ROC 包含虚轴
对于有理系统函数的因果 LTI 系统，稳定的充要条件是所有极点的实部均为负。
例如 因果系统 \(H(s)=\frac{1}{s+a}\) 在 \(\operatorname{Re} a > 0\) 时稳定。
例如 若 \(\operatorname{Re} a < 0\) 且 ROC 为 \(\operatorname{Re} s < -\operatorname{Re} a\)，系统也稳定，但非因果。

title: 第八章 拉普拉斯变换
text:
例


考虑系统函数
\[
H(s) = \frac{1}{s-2} - \frac{1}{s+1}
\]
有两个极点 \(p_{1}=-1\) 和 \(p_{2}=2\)。

\(\operatorname{Re} s < -1\)：非因果，不稳定

\[
h_{1}(t) = -e^{2t} u(-t) + e^{-t} u(-t)
\]

\(-1 < \operatorname{Re} s < 2\)：非因果，稳定

\[
h_{2}(t) = -e^{2t} u(-t) - e^{-t} u(t)
\]

\(\operatorname{Re} s > 2\)：因果，不稳定

\[
h_{3}(t) = e^{2t} u(t) - e^{-t} u(t)
\]

title: 第八章 拉普拉斯变换
text:
线性常系数微分方程
输入输出满足
\[
\sum_{k=0}^{N} a_{k} \frac{d^{k} y}{dt^{k}} = \sum_{k=0}^{M} b_{k} \frac{d^{k} x}{dt^{k}}
\]
两边取拉普拉斯变换：
\[
\sum_{k=0}^{N} a_{k} s^{k} Y(s) = \sum_{k=0}^{M} b_{k} s^{k} X(s)
\]
故系统函数
\[
H(s) = \frac{Y(s)}{X(s)} = \frac{\sum_{k=0}^{M} b_{k} s^{k}}{\sum_{k=0}^{N} a_{k} s^{k}}
\]
系统函数总是有理的。微分方程本身不指定 ROC！需要附加条件（如稳定性、因果性）来确定 \(h(t)\)。

title: 第八章 拉普拉斯变换
text:
例
考虑 LTI 系统满足
\[
y'(t) + 3 y(t) = x'(t) + x(t)
\]
系统函数
\[
H(s) = \frac{s+1}{s+3} = 1 - \frac{2}{s+3}
\]
ROC 有两种可能：\(\operatorname{Re} s > -3\) 和 \(\operatorname{Re} s < -3\)

若 \(\operatorname{Re} s > -3\)（因果且稳定）：

\[
h(t) = \delta(t) - 2 e^{-3t} u(t)
\]

若 \(\operatorname{Re} s < -3\)（反因果且不稳定）：

\[
h(t) = \delta(t) + 2 e^{-3t} u(-t)
\]

title: 第八章 拉普拉斯变换
text:
例（续）
若使用傅里叶变换，频率响应为
\[
H(j\omega) = \frac{j\omega + 1}{j\omega + 3} = 1 - \frac{2}{j\omega + 3}
\]
对应
\[
h(t) = \delta(t) - 2 e^{-3t} u(t)
\]
为什么只有一种可能？

傅里叶变换方法隐含假设系统稳定，要求 \(H(s)\) 的 ROC 包含虚轴，因此 \(\operatorname{Re} s > -3\)；
一般情况下不适用于不稳定系统。

title: 第八章 拉普拉斯变换
text:
例（续）
对输入 \(x(t)=e^{-4t} u(t)\) 求响应。
\[
X(s) = \frac{1}{s+4}, \quad \operatorname{Re} s > -4
\]
响应变换
\[
Y(s) = H(s) X(s) = \frac{s+1}{s+3} \cdot \frac{1}{s+4} = \frac{-2}{s+3} + \frac{3}{s+4}
\]
两种可能 ROC：

\(\operatorname{Re} s > -3\)：

\[
y(t) = -2 e^{-3t} u(t) + 3 e^{-4t} u(t)
\]

\(-4 < \operatorname{Re} s < -3\)：

\[
y(t) = 2 e^{-3t} u(-t) + 3 e^{-4t} u(t)  
\]

title: 第八章 拉普拉斯变换
text:
例（续）
对输入 \(x(t)=e^{-3t} u(t)\) 求响应。
\[
X(s) = \frac{1}{s+3}, \quad \operatorname{Re} s > -3
\]
\[
Y(s) = \frac{s+1}{s+3} \cdot \frac{1}{s+3} = \frac{1}{s+3} - \frac{2}{(s+3)^{2}}
\]
只有一种可能的 ROC \(\operatorname{Re} s > -3\)：
\[
y(t) = (1-2t) e^{-3t} u(t)
\]
对反因果不稳定系统，\(x*h\) 不可定义。

title: 第八章 拉普拉斯变换
text:
例
某 LTI 系统对输入 \(x(t)=e^{-3t} u(t)\) 的响应为
\[
y(t) = (e^{-t} - e^{-2t}) u(t)
\]
系统函数
\[
H(s) = \frac{Y(s)}{X(s)} = \frac{\frac{1}{s+1} - \frac{1}{s+2}}{\frac{1}{s+3}} = \frac{s+3}{s^{2} + 3s + 2}, \quad \operatorname{Re} s > -1
\]
部分分式展开得
\[
H(s) = \frac{2}{s+1} - \frac{1}{s+2}, \quad \operatorname{Re} s > -1 \Longrightarrow h(t) = (2e^{-t} - e^{-2t}) u(t)
\]
该系统可由以下微分方程描述：
\[
\frac{d^{2} y}{dt^{2}} + 3 \frac{dy}{dt} + 2 y = \frac{dx}{dt} + 3 x
\]

title: 第八章 拉普拉斯变换
text:
单边拉普拉斯变换
回忆连续时间信号 \(x(t)\) 的（双边）拉普拉斯变换
\[
X(s)=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} x(t) e^{-s t} \, dt
\]
\(x(t)\) 的单边拉普拉斯变换为
\[
\mathcal{X}(s)=\int_{0_{-}}^{\infty} x(t) e^{-s t} \, dt
\]
也记作
\[
\mathcal{X}=\mathcal{U}\mathcal{L}\{x\}, \quad x(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{UL}}{\longleftrightarrow} \mathcal{X}(s)
\]
\(\mathcal{X}(s)\) 的收敛域始终是右半平面。
注：\(t<0\) 时 \(x(t)\) 的信息在单边变换中丢失。
注：\(\mathcal{L}\{x\}=\mathcal{U}\mathcal{L}\{x\}\) 当且仅当 \(x(t)\) 是因果的，即 \(x(t)=0\) 对 \(t<0\) 成立。

title: 第八章 拉普拉斯变换
text:
例子
单边拉普拉斯变换的计算与双边拉普拉斯变换几乎相同。
例 \(x_{1}(t)=e^{-a t} u(t)\)，
\[
X_{1}(s)=\frac{1}{s+a}, \quad \operatorname{Re} s>-\operatorname{Re} a
\]
例 \(x_{2}(t)=e^{-a(t+1)} u(t+1)=x_{1}(t+1)\)，
\[
\begin{array}{cl}
\text{双边} & X_{2}(s)=e^{s} X_{1}(s)=\frac{e^{s}}{s+a}, \quad \operatorname{Re} s>-\operatorname{Re} a \\
\text{单边} & X_{2}(s)=\int_{0}^{\infty} e^{-a(t+1)} e^{-s t} \, dt=\frac{e^{-a}}{s+a}, \quad \operatorname{Re} s>-\operatorname{Re} a
\end{array}
\]
注：单边 \(X_{2}(s) \neq\) 双边 \(X_{2}(s)\)，因为 \(x_{2}(t)\) 是非因果的。
注：单边变换不满足时移性质，即 \(X_{2}(s) \neq e^{s} X_{1}(s)\)。

title: 第八章 拉普拉斯变换
text:
例子
单边拉普拉斯变换的计算与双边几乎相同。
例 \(x_{3}(t)=e^{-a|t|}\)，\(\operatorname{Re} a>0\)，
\[
\begin{aligned}
\text{双边} & X_{3}(s)=\frac{-2a}{s^{2}-a^{2}}, \quad -\operatorname{Re} a < \operatorname{Re} s < \operatorname{Re} a \\
\text{单边} & X_{3}(s)=\frac{1}{s+a}, \quad \operatorname{Re} s>-\operatorname{Re} a
\end{aligned}
\]
注：\(X_{3}(s) \neq X_{1}(s)\)，因为 \(x_{3}(t) \neq x_{1}(t)\)。
注：单边 \(X_{3}(s) = X_{1}(s)\)，因为 \(x_{3}(t)\) 与 \(x_{1}(t)\) 仅在 \(t<0\) 处不同。
例 \(x(t)=\delta(t)+2\delta'(t)+e^{t} u(t)\)，
\[
X(s)=\mathcal{X}(s)=1+2s+\frac{1}{s-1}, \quad \operatorname{Re} s>1
\]
注：积分下限为 \(0_{-}\)，因此 \(\delta(t)\) 和 \(\delta'(t)\) 对单边变换有贡献。

title: 第八章 拉普拉斯变换
text:
例子
单边拉普拉斯逆变换的计算与双边相同，但只能恢复 \(t \geq 0\) 的信号！
例 已知单边拉普拉斯变换
\[
X(s)=\frac{1}{(s+1)(s+2)}=\frac{1}{s+1}-\frac{1}{s+2}
\]
唯一可能的 ROC 是 \(\operatorname{Re} s>-1\)，因此
\[
x(t)=e^{-t}-e^{-2t}, \quad t \geq 0
\]
\(X(s)\) 对 \(t<0\) 的 \(x(t)\) 无任何信息。
例 \(\mathcal{X}(s)=\frac{s^{2}-3}{s+2}=-2+s+\frac{1}{s+2}\)，ROC 必为 \(\operatorname{Re} s>-2\)，故
\[
x(t)=-2\delta(t)+\delta'(t)+e^{-2t}, \quad t \geq 0
\]

title: 第八章 拉普拉斯变换
section: 单边拉普拉斯变换的卷积性质
text:
单边拉普拉斯变换的卷积性质
若 \(x(t)=y(t)=0\) 对 \(t<0\) 成立，则
\[
(x * y)(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{UL}}{\longleftrightarrow} X(s) Y(s), \quad \text{ROAC} \supset \operatorname{ROAC}_{x} \cap \operatorname{ROAC}_{y}
\]
证明 因为 \((x*y)(t)=0\) 对 \(t<0\) 成立，
\[
\mathcal{U}\mathcal{L}\{x*y\}=\mathcal{L}\{x*y\}=\mathcal{L}\{x\}\mathcal{L}\{y\}=\mathcal{U}\mathcal{L}\{x\}\mathcal{U}\mathcal{L}\{y\}
\]
注意：\(x(t)=y(t)=0\) 对 \(t<0\) 的假设非常重要！
例 \(x(t)=\delta(t)-\delta(t-1)\)，\(y(t)=\delta(t+1)\)，
\[
X(s)=1-e^{-s}, \quad Y(s)=0
\]
但 \((x*y)(t)=\delta(t+1)-\delta(t)\)，
\[
\mathcal{U}\mathcal{L}\{x*y\}=-1 \neq X(s)Y(s)
\]

title: 第八章 拉普拉斯变换
text:
时域积分性质
若
\[
x(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{UL}}{\longleftrightarrow} X(s), \quad \text{ROAC}=R
\]
则
\[
\int_{0_{-}}^{t} x(\tau) \, d\tau \stackrel{\mathcal{UL}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{1}{s} X(s), \quad \text{ROAC} \supset R \cap \{\operatorname{Re} s>0\}
\]
证明 对 \(\tilde{x} * u\) 应用卷积性质，其中
\[
\tilde{x}(t) = \begin{cases}
x(t), & t \geq 0 \\
0, & t<0
\end{cases}
\]
例 \(x(t)=\delta(t)\)，\(X(s)=1\)，则
\[
\int_{0_{-}}^{t} x(\tau) \, d\tau = u(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{UL}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{1}{s}, \quad \operatorname{Re} s>0
\]

title: 第八章 拉普拉斯变换
text:
时域微分性质
若
\[
x(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{UL}}{\longleftrightarrow} X(s), \quad \text{ROC}=R
\]
且对 \(s \in R_{0}\) 有 \(\lim_{t\to+\infty} x(t) e^{-s t}=0\)，则
\[
\frac{d}{dt} x(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{UL}}{\longleftrightarrow} s X(s) - x(0_{-}), \quad \text{ROC} \supset R \cap R_{0}
\]
注：\(R_{0} \supset\) \(X(s)\) 的 ROAC（双边拉普拉斯变换也成立）。
证明 分部积分：
\[
\int_{0_{-}}^{\infty} x'(t) e^{-s t} \, dt = \left. x(t) e^{-s t} \right|_{0_{-}}^{\infty} + s \int_{0_{-}}^{\infty} x(t) e^{-s t} \, dt = -x(0_{-}) + s X(s)
\]
注：若采用积分下限 \(0_{+}\) 的定义，则有 \(\frac{d}{dt}x(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{UL}}{\longleftrightarrow} s X(s) - x(0_{+})\)。

title: 第八章 拉普拉斯变换
text:
时域微分性质
例 \(x(t)=e^{-t}\)，\(\mathcal{X}(s)=\frac{1}{s+1}\)，ROAC \(\operatorname{Re} s>-1\)。由微分性质：
\[
x'(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{UL}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{s}{s+1} - 1 = -\frac{1}{s+1}, \quad \operatorname{ROC} \supset \{\operatorname{Re} s>-1\}
\]
直接计算验证一致。
例 \(x(t)=e^{-t} u(t)\)，\(X(s)=\frac{1}{s+1}\)，ROAC \(\operatorname{Re} s>-1\)。由微分性质得
\[
x'(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{UL}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{s}{s+1}
\]
直接计算：\(x'(t)=\delta(t)-e^{-t}u(t)\)，
\[
\mathcal{U}\mathcal{L}\{x'\}=\frac{s}{s+1}
\]

title: 第八章 拉普拉斯变换
text:
时域微分性质
在适当条件下（如 \(x^{(k)}(t)=O(e^{\gamma t})\)），微分性质可推广到高阶导数：
\[
x^{(n)}(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{UL}}{\longleftrightarrow} s^{n} X(s) - \sum_{k=0}^{n-1} s^{n-1-k} x^{(k)}(0_{-})
\]
常系数微分方程的解形式为 \(\sum p_{i}(t) e^{a_{i} t}\)（\(p_{i}\) 为多项式），满足上述条件。
单边拉普拉斯变换特别适用于求解具有非零初始条件的常系数微分方程。

title: 第八章 拉普拉斯变换
text:
初值定理
定理 若 \(x(t)\) 的单边拉普拉斯变换 \(\mathcal{X}(s)\) 是有理严格真函数，则
\[
x(0_{+}) = \lim_{s \to \infty} s \mathcal{X}(s)
\]
证明 \(\mathcal{X}(s)\) 的部分分式展开为
\[
\mathcal{X}(s)=\sum_{i=1}^{r} \sum_{k_{i}=1}^{N_{i}} \frac{A_{i,k_{i}}}{(s+a_{i})^{k_{i}}}
\]
\[
x(t)=\sum_{i=1}^{r} \sum_{k_{i}=1}^{N_{i}} \frac{A_{i,k_{i}} t^{k_{i}-1}}{(k_{i}-1)!} e^{-a_{i} t}, \quad t \geq 0
\]
于是
\[
x(0_{+})=\sum_{i=1}^{r} A_{i,1} = \lim_{s\to\infty} s \mathcal{X}(s)
\]
例 \(x(t)=2e^{-t}+e^{-2t}\)，\(\mathcal{X}(s)=\frac{3s+5}{s^{2}+3s+2}\)，\(x(0_{+})=\lim_{s\to\infty} s\mathcal{X}(s)=3\)。

title: 第八章 拉普拉斯变换
section: 初值定理（非严格真情况）
text:
初值定理（非严格真情况）
若 \(\mathcal{X}(s)\) 是有理但非严格真函数，
\[
\mathcal{X}(s)=\sum_{k=0}^{n} a_{k} s^{k} + \mathcal{X}_{1}(s)
\]
其中 \(\mathcal{X}_{1}(s)\) 是严格真有理函数。逆变换为
\[
x(t)=\sum_{k=0}^{n} a_{k} \delta^{(k)}(t) + x_{1}(t)
\]
因此
\[
x(0_{+})=x_{1}(0_{+})=\lim_{s\to\infty} s \mathcal{X}_{1}(s)
\]
例 \(x(t)=\delta(t)+2e^{-t}\)，\(X(s)=1+\frac{2}{s+1}=\frac{s+3}{s+1}\)，
\[
x(0_{+})=2=\lim_{s\to\infty} \frac{2s}{s+1} \neq \lim_{s\to\infty} s X(s)
\]

title: 第八章 拉普拉斯变换
text:
例
因果 LTI 系统，系统函数
\[
H(s) = \frac{1}{(s+1)(s+2)} = \frac{1}{s+1}\frac{1}{ s+2}
\]
级联形式

title: 第八章 拉普拉斯变换
text:
终值定理
定理 假设 \(x(t)\) 在 \(t \geq 0\) 时不含 \(\delta(t)\) 及其导数。若 \(X(s)\) 对实数 \(s>0\) 收敛，且 \(\lim_{t\to+\infty} x(t)\) 存在有限，则
\[
\lim_{t\to+\infty} x(t) = \lim_{s\to 0_{+}} s X(s)
\]
证明
根据拉普拉斯变换的微分性质： \[\mathcal{L}\{x'(t)\} = \int_{0^-}^{\infty} x'(t)e^{-st} dt = sX(s) - x(0^-)\]
由于 \(x(t)\) 为因果信号且不含 \(t=0\) 处的冲激，故 \(x(0^-) = 0\)。上式简化为： \[sX(s) = \int_{0^-}^{\infty} x'(t)e^{-st} dt = \int_{0^-}^{\epsilon} x'(t)e^{-st} dt + \int_{\epsilon}^{\infty} x'(t)e^{-st} dt\]
令 \(s \to \infty\)：

对于第一部分积分，由于区间极小且 \(x'(t)\) 连续，该项趋于 \(x(0^+) - x(0^-) = x(0^+)\)。

title: 第八章 拉普拉斯变换
text:
终值定理（扩展）
终值定理可扩展至允许 \(t>0\) 上有有限个 \(\delta\) 及其导数的情况。此时
\[
x(t)=x_{1}(t)+\sum a_{i} \delta^{(k_{i})}(t-t_{i}) \stackrel{\mathcal{UL}}{\longleftrightarrow} X(s)=X_{1}(s)+\sum a_{i} s^{k_{i}} e^{-s t_{i}}
\]
\[
\lim_{t\to+\infty} x(t)=\lim_{t\to+\infty} x_{1}(t)=\lim_{s\to 0_{+}} s X_{1}(s)=\lim_{s\to 0_{+}} s X(s)
\]
例 \(x(t)=\delta(t)+2\)，\(\mathcal{X}(s)=\frac{1}{s}+1\)，\(x(+\infty)=2=\lim_{s\to 0_{+}} s \mathcal{X}(s)\)。

title: 第八章 拉普拉斯变换
text:
线性常系数微分方程
考虑常系数微分方程
\[
\sum_{k=0}^{N} a_{k} \frac{d^{k} y}{dt^{k}} = \sum_{k=0}^{M} b_{k} \frac{d^{k} x}{dt^{k}}
\]
初始条件 \(y^{(k)}(0_{-})\) 已知，输入因果（\(x(t)=0\) 对 \(t<0\)）。
两边取单边拉普拉斯变换：
\[
\sum_{k=0}^{N} a_{k} \left[ s^{k} Y(s) - \sum_{\ell=0}^{k-1} s^{k-1-\ell} y^{(\ell)}(0_{-}) \right] = \sum_{k=0}^{M} b_{k} s^{k} X(s)
\]
整理得
\[
Y(s) = \underbrace{\frac{\sum b_{k} s^{k}}{\sum a_{k} s^{k}} X(s)}_{\text{零状态响应}} + \underbrace{\frac{\sum_{k=0}^{N} a_{k} \sum_{\ell=0}^{k-1} s^{k-1-\ell} y^{(\ell)}(0_{-}) }{\sum a_{k} s^{k}} }_{\text{零输入响应}}
\]

title: 第八章 拉普拉斯变换
第八章 拉普拉斯变换
section: 拉普拉斯变换及其收敛域
text:
拉普拉斯变换及其收敛域
回忆连续时间 LTI 系统对输入 \(x(t)=e^{s t}\) 的响应为
\[
y(t)=(x * h)(t)=H(s) e^{s t}
\]
其中 \(h\) 是系统的冲激响应，且
\[
H(s)=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} h(t) e^{-s t} \, dt
\]
系统函数 \(H(s)\) 称为 \(h\) 的拉普拉斯变换。
一般地，连续时间信号 \(x(t)\) 的拉普拉斯变换为
\[
X(s)=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} x(t) e^{-s t} \, dt=\lim _{\substack{T_{1} \rightarrow \infty \\ T_{2} \rightarrow \infty}} \int_{-T_{1}}^{T_{2}} x(t) e^{-s t} \, dt
\]
也可记作
\[
X=\mathcal{L}\{x\}, \quad \text { 或 } \quad x(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} X(s)
\] 复变量\(s\)一般可写成\(s=\sigma+j\omega\)

title: 拉普拉斯变换实例分析：指数信号
text:
对于信号 \(x(t) = e^{-at}u(t)\)，其拉普拉斯变换定义为：
\[
X(s) = \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} e^{-at}u(t)e^{-st} dt = \int_{0}^{\infty} e^{-(s+a)t} dt
\]
计算积分得：
\[
X(s) = \lim_{T \to \infty} \left[ \frac{1 - e^{-(s+a)T}}{s + a} \right] = \frac{1}{s + a}
\]

title: 拉普拉斯变换实例分析：指数信号
text:
为什么收敛域 (ROC) 是 \(Re \{s\} > -Re \{a\}\)？
收敛域取决于积分 \(\int_{0}^{\infty} e^{-(s+a)t} dt\) 是否存在（即是否趋于有限值）。

1. 数学推导
设复变量 \(s = \sigma + j\omega\)，复常数 \(a = a_r + ja_i\)。 则指数项的模为： \[|e^{-(s+a)t}| = |e^{-(\sigma + a_r)t} \cdot e^{-j(\omega + a_i)t}| = e^{-(\sigma + a_r)t}\]
为了使 \(t \to \infty\) 时积分收敛，指数部分的指数必须为负数： \[-(\sigma + a_r) < 0 \implies \sigma > -a_r\]
写成复数形式即为： \[Re \{s\} > -Re \{a\}\]


2. 物理意义与稳定性分析
根据 \(Re \{a\}\) 的取值，系统的性质会有所不同：

若 \(Re \{a\} > 0\)：

收敛域包含虚轴 (\(j\omega\) 轴)。
傅里叶变换存在，且为 \(X(j\omega) = \frac{1}{j\omega + a}\)。
此时信号是平方可积的，系统稳定。

若 \(Re \{a\} < 0\)：

收敛域不包含虚轴。
连续时间傅里叶变换不存在。
此时信号随时间指数增长，系统不稳定。

若 \(Re \{a\} = 0\)（即 \(a\) 为纯虚数 \(j\omega_0\)）：

傅里叶变换仅以冲击函数（分布形式）存在： \[\mathcal{F}\{x\}(j\omega) = \frac{1}{j(\omega + \omega_0)} + \pi \delta(\omega + \omega_0)\]
注意：此时 \(\mathcal{F}\{x\}(j\omega) \neq X(s)|_{s=j\omega}\)。

title: 拉普拉斯变换实例分析：指数信号
text:
结论提炼

收敛条件：拉普拉斯变换的积分要在 \(t \to \infty\) 时衰减，要求 \(s\) 的实部足够大，以抵消信号可能的增长。
ROC 与极点：本例的极点位于 \(s = -a\)。对于右边信号，收敛域总是位于最右侧极点的右侧复半平面。

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
卷积性质
If
\[
\begin{array}{ll}
x(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} X(s) & \text { with } \text { ROAC }=R_{1} \\
y(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} Y(s) & \text { with ROAC }=R_{2}
\end{array}
\]
then
\[
(x * y)(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} X(s) Y(s) \quad \text { with ROAC } \supset R_{1} \cap R_{2}
\]
A more precise statement is the following. Theorem. If both \(X(s)=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} x(t) e^{-s t} d t\) and \(Y(s)=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} y(t) e^{-s t} d t\) converges absolutely at some \(s=s_{0}\), then the Laplace transform of \(z=x * y\) converges absolutely at \(s=s_{0}\), and
\[
X\left(s_{0}\right) Y\left(s_{0}\right)=Z\left(s_{0}\right)=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} z(t) e^{-s_{0} t} d t
\]

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
卷积性质
证明.
\[
\begin{aligned}
X(s) Y(s) & =\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} x(v)\left[\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} y(\tau) e^{-s(v+\tau)} d v\right] d \tau \\
& =\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} x(v)\left[\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} y(t-v) e^{-s v} d v\right] d t \quad(t=v+\tau) \\
& =\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\left[\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} x(v) y(t-v) d t\right] e^{-s v} d v \quad \text { (Fubini's Theorem) }
\end{aligned}
\]
NB. The ROAC of \(\mathcal{L}\{x * y\}\) may be larger than the common ROAC of \(\mathcal{L}\{x\}\) and \(\mathcal{L}\{y\}\).
例. \(X_{1}(s)=\frac{s+1}{(s+2)^{2}}\) has ROAC \(\operatorname{Re} s>-2, X_{2}(s)=\frac{1}{s+1}\) has ROAC Re \(s>-1\), but \(X(s)=X_{1}(s) X_{2}(s)=\frac{1}{(s+2)^{2}}\) with ROAC \(\operatorname{Re} s>-2\), due to pole-zero cancellation at \(s=-1\).

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
时域微分性质
If
\[
x(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} X(s), \quad \text { with } \text { ROC }=R
\]
and \(\lim _{t \rightarrow \pm \infty} x(t) e^{-s t}=0\) for \(s \in R_{0}\), then
\[
\frac{d}{d t} x(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} s X(s), \quad \text { with } \mathrm{ROC} \supset R \cap R_{0}
\]
证明. Integration by parts yields
\[
\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} x^{\prime}(t) e^{-s t} d t=\left.x(t) e^{-s t}\right|_{-\infty} ^{\infty}+s \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} x(t) e^{-s t} d t=s \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} x(t) e^{-s t} d t
\]
NB. ROC may enlarge or shrink 例. \(x(t)=\left(1-e^{-t}\right) u(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{1}{s(s+1)}\) with ROC = ROAC \(\operatorname{Re} s>0\), and \(x^{\prime}(t)=e^{-t} u(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{1}{s+1}\) with ROC = ROAC \(\operatorname{Re} s>-1\). The ROC of \(\mathcal{L}\left\{x^{\prime}\right\}\) is larger that that of \(\mathcal{L}\{x\}\).

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
时域微分性质
例. Consider \(x(t)=e^{k t} \sin \left(e^{k t}\right)\) with \(k>0\).

For \(s=\sigma \in \mathbb{R}, u=e^{k t}\) yields (cf. slide 18)

\[
\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} x(t) e^{-s t} d t=\frac{1}{k} \int_{0}^{\infty} \frac{\sin u}{u^{\sigma / k}} d u=\frac{1}{k} \int_{0}^{1} \frac{\sin u}{u^{\sigma / k}} d u+\frac{1}{k} \int_{1}^{\infty} \frac{\sin u}{u^{\sigma / k}} d u
\]

\(\int_{1}^{\infty} \frac{\sin u}{u^{\sigma / k}} d u\) has ROAC \(\operatorname{Re} s>k\) and ROC \(\operatorname{Re} s>0\)
As \(u \downarrow 0, \frac{\sin u}{u^{\sigma / k}} \sim u^{1-\sigma / k}\), so \(\int_{0}^{1} \frac{\sin u}{u^{\sigma / k}} d u\) has ROAC \(\operatorname{Re} s<2 k\)
Thus \(\mathcal{L}\{x\}\) has \(\operatorname{ROC} k<\operatorname{Re} s<2 k\) and \(\operatorname{ROC} 0<\operatorname{Re} s<2 k\).
\(x^{\prime}(t)=k e^{k t} \sin \left(e^{k t}\right)+k e^{2 k t} \cos \left(e^{k t}\right)\). For \(s=\sigma \in \mathbb{R}\),

\[
\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} x^{\prime}(t) e^{-s t} d t=\int_{0}^{\infty} \frac{\sin u+u \cos u}{u^{\sigma / k}} d u
\]
\(\mathcal{L}\left\{x^{\prime}\right\}\) has empty ROAC, and ROC \(k<\operatorname{Re} s<2 k\)

Note \(\lim _{t \rightarrow \pm \infty} x(t) e^{-s t}=0\) fails for \(s\) with \(0<\operatorname{Re} s<k\)

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
时域微分性质
If \(x(t)=O\left(e^{a t}\right)\) as \(t \rightarrow+\infty\) and \(x(t)=O\left(e^{b t}\right)\) as \(t \rightarrow-\infty\), then
\[
x(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} X(s), \quad \text { with ROAC containing } a<\operatorname{Re} s<b
\]
and
\[
\frac{d}{d t} x(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} s X(s), \quad \text { with ROC containing } a<\operatorname{Re} s<b
\]
NB. In general, from the absolute convergence of \(\mathcal{L}\{x\}\) at \(s=s_{0}\) we can only conclude the convergence of \(\mathcal{L}\left\{x^{\prime}\right\}\) at \(s=s_{0}\).
NB. We mostly deal with \(x(t)\) of the form \(\sum_{k=0}^{m} p_{k}(t) e^{\alpha_{k} t} u\left( \pm t+\beta_{k}\right)\), where \(p_{k}\) are polynomials. After introducing Laplace transform for singularity functions, we have for such functions,
\[
\frac{d^{n}}{d t^{n}} x(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} s^{n} X(s), \quad \text { with ROC containing } a<\operatorname{Re} s<b
\]

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
\(s\) 域微分性质
If
\[
x(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} X(s), \quad \operatorname{ROAC} \sigma_{1}<\operatorname{Re} s<\sigma_{2}
\]
then
\[
-t x(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{d}{d s} X(s), \quad \operatorname{ROAC} \sigma_{1}<\operatorname{Re} s<\sigma_{2}
\]
“证明”. Differentiating under integral sign (can be justified)
\[
\frac{d}{d s} \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} x(t) e^{-s t} d t=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} x(t) \frac{d}{d s} e^{-s t} d t=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}-t x(t) e^{-s t} d t
\]
例.
\[
e^{-a t} u(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{1}{s+a}, \quad \operatorname{Re} s>-a
\]
\[
t^{n} e^{-a t} u(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow}\left(-\frac{d}{d s}\right)^{n} \frac{1}{s+a}=\frac{n!}{(s+a)^{n+1}}, \quad \operatorname{Re} s>-a
\]
Similarly,
\[
-t^{n} e^{-a t} u(-t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{n!}{(s+a)^{n+1}}, \quad \operatorname{Re} s<-a
\]

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
时域积分性质
If
\[
x(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} X(s), \quad \text { ROAC }=R
\]
then
\[
\int_{-\infty}^{t} x(\tau) d \tau \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{1}{s} X(s), \quad \text { ROAC } \supset R \cap\{\operatorname{Re} s>0\}
\]
证明. Follows from convolution property and the following
\[
\int_{-\infty}^{t} x(\tau) d \tau=(x * u)(t)
\]
and
\[
u(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{1}{s} \text { with ROAC }=\{\operatorname{Re} s>0\}
\]
NB. This property holds also for Laplace transforms of singularity functions and will be useful computing some Laplace transforms.

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
拉普拉斯逆变换
Recall Laplace transform is related to CTFT by
\[
X(\sigma+j \omega)=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\left\{x(t) e^{-\sigma t}\right\} e^{-j \omega t} d t=\mathcal{F}\left\{x(t) e^{-\sigma t}\right\}
\]
Take the inverse Fourier transform for \(s=\sigma+j \omega \in \mathrm{ROC}\),
\[
x(t) e^{-\sigma t}=\frac{1}{2 \pi} \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} X(\sigma+j \omega) e^{j \omega t} d \omega
\]
so
\[
x(t)=\frac{1}{2 \pi} \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} X(\sigma+j \omega) e^{(\sigma+j \omega) t} d \omega
\]
or
\[
x(t)=\frac{1}{j 2 \pi} \int_{\sigma-j \infty}^{\sigma+j \infty} X(s) e^{s t} d s=\lim _{A \rightarrow \infty} \frac{1}{j 2 \pi} \int_{\sigma-j A}^{\sigma+j A} X(s) e^{s t} d s
\]

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
section: Inverse Transform by Partial Fraction Expansion
text:
Inverse Transform by Partial Fraction Expansion
For rational Laplace transform, the inverse transform can be found by partial fraction expansion.
Recall a proper rational function has the following partial fraction expansion
\[
R(s)=\sum_{i=1}^{r} \sum_{k_{i}=1}^{N_{i}} \frac{A_{i, k_{i}}}{\left(s+a_{i}\right)^{k_{i}}}
\]
Also recall
\[
\begin{aligned}
\frac{t^{n-1}}{(n-1)!} e^{-a t} u(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{1}{(s+a)^{n}}, & \operatorname{Re} s>-a \\
-\frac{t^{n-1}}{(n-1)!} e^{-a t} u(-t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{1}{(s+a)^{n}}, & \operatorname{Re} s<-a
\end{aligned}
\]
By linearity, \(\mathcal{L}^{-1}\{R\}\) is a linear combination of terms of the above form, where signs are chosen according to the ROC.

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
例
Consider a rational Laplace transform \(X(s)=\frac{1}{(s+1)(s+2)^{2}}\)
\[
X(s)=\frac{1}{s+1}+\frac{-1}{s+2}+\frac{-1}{(s+2)^{2}}
\]
Two poles at \(s=-1\) and \(s=-2\).

If ROC is \(\operatorname{Re} s>-1\)

\[
x(t)=e^{-t} u(t)-(1+t) e^{-2 t} u(t)
\]

If ROC is \(\operatorname{Re} s<-2\)

\[
x(t)=-e^{-t} u(-t)+(1+t) e^{-2 t} u(-t)
\]

If ROC is \(-2<\operatorname{Re} s<-1\)

\[
x(t)=-e^{-t} u(-t)-(1+t) e^{-2 t} u(t)
\]

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
Inverse Transform by Contour Integration
Suppose \(X(s)\) has finitely many finite isolated singularities \(s_{1}, \ldots, s_{n}\), and ROC is \(-\infty \leq \sigma_{1}<\operatorname{Re} s<\sigma_{2} \leq+\infty\).
The inverse transform is
\[
x(t)=\lim _{r \rightarrow \infty} \frac{1}{j 2 \pi} \int_{\sigma-j r}^{\sigma+j r} X(s) e^{s t} d s
\]
where \(\sigma_{1}<\sigma<\sigma_{2}\). For \(t>0\), choose a large semicircle \(C_{r}\) that encloses all \(s_{k}\) with \(\operatorname{Re} s \leq \sigma_{1}\).
If \(X(s)\) satisfies \({ }^{1}\) (a shifted and rotated version of) Jordan’s Lemma (slide 6, Lecture 27), Residue Theorem implies 
\[
x(t)=\sum_{k: s_{k} \leq \sigma_{1}} \operatorname{Res}\left[X(s) e^{s t}, s_{k}\right], \quad t>0
\]
\({ }^{1}\) satisfied by proper rational functions

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
Inverse Transform by Contour Integration
Suppose \(X(s)\) has finitely many finite isolated singularities \(s_{1}, \ldots, s_{n}\), and ROC is \(-\infty \leq \sigma_{1}<\operatorname{Re} s<\sigma_{2} \leq+\infty\).
The inverse transform is
\[
x(t)=\lim _{r \rightarrow \infty} \frac{1}{j 2 \pi} \int_{\sigma-j r}^{\sigma+j r} X(s) e^{s t} d s
\]
where \(\sigma_{1}<\sigma<\sigma_{2}\). For \(t<0\), choose a large semicircle \(C_{r}\) that encloses all \(s_{k}\) with \(\operatorname{Re} s \geq \sigma_{2}\).
If \(X(s)\) satisfies (a shifted and rotated version of) Jordan’s Lemma, Residue Theorem implies
\[
x(t)=-\sum_{k: s_{k} \geq \sigma_{2}} \operatorname{Res}\left[X(s) e^{s t}, s_{k}\right], \quad t<0
\]

Caution. Negative sign due to negative orientation of contour.

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
例
Consider a rational Laplace transform \(X(s)=\frac{1}{(s+1)(s+2)^{2}}\)
\[
\begin{gathered}
\operatorname{Res}\left[X(s) e^{s t},-1\right]=\left.\frac{e^{s t}}{(s+2)^{2}}\right|_{s=-1}=e^{-t} \\
\operatorname{Res}\left[X(s) e^{s t},-2\right]=\left[\frac{d}{d s} \frac{e^{s t}}{s+1}\right]_{s=-2}=-(1+t) e^{-2 t}
\end{gathered}
\]

If ROC is \(\operatorname{Re} s>-1\), then \(\sigma_{1}=-1, \sigma_{2}=+\infty\).

For \(t>0\),
\[
x(t)=\sum_{k: \operatorname{Re} s_{k} \leq-1} \operatorname{Res}\left[X(s) e^{s t}, s_{k}\right]=e^{-t}-(1+t) e^{-2 t}
\]
For \(t<0\),
\[
x(t)=-\sum_{k: \operatorname{Re} s_{k} \geq+\infty} \operatorname{Res}\left[X(s) e^{s t}, s_{k}\right]=0
\]

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
例 (cont’d)
Consider a rational Laplace transform \(X(s)=\frac{1}{(s+1)(s+2)^{2}}\)
\[
\begin{gathered}
\operatorname{Res}\left[X(s) e^{s t},-1\right]=\left.\frac{e^{s t}}{(s+2)^{2}}\right|_{s=-1}=e^{-t} \\
\operatorname{Res}\left[X(s) e^{s t},-2\right]=\left[\frac{d}{d s} \frac{e^{s t}}{s+1}\right]_{s=-2}=-(1+t) e^{-2 t}
\end{gathered}
\]

If ROC is \(\operatorname{Re} s<-2\), then \(\sigma_{1}=-\infty, \sigma_{2}=-2\).

For \(t>0\),
\[
x(t)=\sum_{k: \operatorname{Re} s_{k} \leq-\infty} \operatorname{Res}\left[X(s) e^{s t}, s_{k}\right]=0
\]
For \(t<0\),
\[
x(t)=-\sum_{k: \operatorname{Re} s_{k} \geq-2} \operatorname{Res}\left[X(s) e^{s t}, s_{k}\right]=-e^{-t}+(1+t) e^{-2 t}
\]

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
例 (cont’d)
Consider a rational Laplace transform \(X(s)=\frac{1}{(s+1)(s+2)^{2}}\)
\[
\begin{gathered}
\operatorname{Res}\left[X(s) e^{s t},-1\right]=\left.\frac{e^{s t}}{(s+2)^{2}}\right|_{s=-1}=e^{-t} \\
\operatorname{Res}\left[X(s) e^{s t},-2\right]=\left[\frac{d}{d s} \frac{e^{s t}}{s+1}\right]_{s=-2}=-(1+t) e^{-2 t}
\end{gathered}
\]

If ROC is \(-2<\operatorname{Re} s<-1\), then \(\sigma_{1}=-2, \sigma_{2}=-1\).

For \(t>0\),
\[
x(t)=\sum_{k: \operatorname{Re} s_{k} \leq-2} \operatorname{Res}\left[X(s) e^{s t}, s_{k}\right]=-(1+t) e^{-2 t}
\]
For \(t<0\),
\[
x(t)=-\sum_{k: \operatorname{Re} s_{k} \geq-1} \operatorname{Res}\left[X(s) e^{s t}, s_{k}\right]=-e^{-t}
\]

text:
奇异函数的拉普拉斯变换
The properties of Laplace transforms discussed previously still holds for this generalization.
例. The property of time differentiation is equivalent to the convolution property involving \(\delta^{\prime}\).
\[
\mathcal{L}\left\{x^{\prime}\right\}=\mathcal{L}\left\{x * \delta^{\prime}\right\}=\mathcal{L}\{x\} \mathcal{L}\left\{\delta^{\prime}\right\}=s \mathcal{L}\{x\}
\]
例.    \(X_{2}(s)=-\frac{4}{T}+\frac{2}{T} e^{-s \frac{T}{2}}+\frac{2}{T} e^{s \frac{T}{2}}=\frac{8}{T} \sinh ^{2}\left(\frac{s T}{4}\right) \Longrightarrow X(s)=\frac{X_{2}(s)}{s^{2}}\)

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
拉普拉斯逆变换
Recall a rational function can be written as the sum of a polynomial and a proper rational function
\[
R(s)=\sum_{k=1}^{n} a_{k} s^{k}+R_{1}(s)
\]
Thus
\[
\mathcal{L}^{-1}\{R\}=\sum_{k=1}^{n} a_{k} \delta^{(k)}(t)+\mathcal{L}^{-1}\left\{R_{1}\right\}
\]
where \(\mathcal{L}^{-1}\left\{R_{1}\right\}\) can be found by partial fraction expansion or contour integration.
例. \(X(s)=\frac{s(s+2)}{s+3}=s-1+\frac{3}{s+3}\) with \(\operatorname{ROC} \operatorname{Re} s>-3\), so
\[
x(t)=\delta^{\prime}(t)-\delta(t)+3 e^{-3 t} u(t)
\]

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
CT System Function
Recall the response of a CT LTI system to the input \(x(t)\) is
\[
y(t)=(x * h)(t)
\]
where \(h\) is the impulse response of the system. If \(x\) and \(h\) have Laplace transforms, the convolution property implies
\[
Y(s)=X(s) H(s)
\]
in their common \(\mathrm{ROC}^{2}\). If the ROC has a nonempty interior point, the system function (aka transfer function) \(H(s)\) uniquely determines \(h\) and hence system properties through the inverse Laplace transform (this can be proved, but we will not do so).
1 ## 因果性
Recall \(h\) is right-sided iff the ROC of \(H(s)\) is a right half-plane, causal \(\Longrightarrow \mathrm{ROC}\) is a right half-plane
Caution. The converse is not true. 例. Consider \(H(s)=\frac{e^{s}}{s+1}\) with \(\operatorname{ROC} \operatorname{Re} s>-1\). By the time-shift property,
\[
h(t)=e^{-(t+1)} u(t+1)
\]
which is not causal.

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
因果性
An LTI system with rational system function \(H(s)\) is causal iff the ROC is the right half-plane to the rightmost pole.
证明. Recall for a rational system function,
\[
H(s)=\sum_{k=1}^{n} a_{k} s^{k}+\sum_{i=1}^{r} \sum_{k_{i}=1}^{N_{i}} \frac{A_{i, k_{i}}}{\left(s+a_{i}\right)^{k_{i}}}, \quad \operatorname{Re} s>\max _{i} \operatorname{Re}\left(-a_{i}\right)
\]
SO
\[
h(t)=\sum_{k=1}^{n} a_{k} \delta^{(k)}(t)+\sum_{i=1}^{r} \sum_{k_{i}=1}^{N_{i}} \frac{A_{i, k_{i}}}{\left(k_{i}-1\right)!} t^{k_{i}-1} e^{-a_{i} t} u(t)
\]
which is causal. (Can also prove by contour integration.) 例. \(h(t)=e^{-t} u(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} H(s)=\frac{1}{s+1}\) with \(\operatorname{Re} s>-1\), causal. 例. \(h(t)=e^{-|t|} \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} H(s)=\frac{-2}{s^{2}-1}\) with \(-1<\operatorname{Re} s<1\), noncausal.

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
稳定性
Recall an LTI system is stable iff its impulse response \(h \in L_{1}\), i.e.
\[
\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}|h(t)| d t<\infty
\]
i.e. \(H(s)\) converges absolutely on the imaginary axis \(\operatorname{Re} s=0\), so its \(\operatorname{ROC}-\infty \leq \sigma_{1}<\operatorname{Re} s<\sigma_{2} \leq \infty\) must satisfy \(\sigma_{1}<0<\sigma_{2}\).
stable \(\Longleftrightarrow\) ROC includes the imaginary axis
A causal LTI system with rational system function \(H(s)\) is stable iff all its poles have negative real parts.
例. A causal system with \(H(s)=\frac{1}{s+a}\) is stable iff \(\operatorname{Re} a>0\) 例. A system with \(H(s)=\frac{1}{s+a}\) where \(\operatorname{Re} a<0\) and ROC \(\operatorname{Re} s<-\operatorname{Re} a\) is also stable, but it is noncausal.

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
例
Consider the system function
\[
H(s)=\frac{1}{s-2}-\frac{1}{s+1}
\]
There are two poles \(p_{1}=-1\) and \(p_{2}=2\).

Re \(s<-1\), noncausal, unstable

\[
h_{1}(t)=-e^{2 t} u(-t)+e^{-t} u(-t)
\]
 2. \(-1<\operatorname{Re} s<2\), noncausal, stable
\[
h_{2}(t)=-e^{2 t} u(-t)-e^{-t} u(t)
\]

\(\operatorname{Re} s>2\), causal, unstable

\[
h_{3}(t)=e^{2 t} u(t)-e^{-t} u(t)
\]

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
线性常系数微分方程
LTI system with input and output related by
\[
\sum_{k=0}^{N} a_{k} \frac{d^{k} y}{d t^{k}}=\sum_{k=0}^{M} b_{k} \frac{d^{k} x}{d t^{k}}
\]
Take Laplace transform of both sides
\[
\sum_{k=0}^{N} a_{k} s^{k} Y(s)=\sum_{k=0}^{M} b_{k} s^{k} X(s)
\]
so
\[
H(s)=\frac{Y(s)}{X(s)}=\frac{\sum_{k=0}^{M} b_{k} s^{k}}{\sum_{k=0}^{N} a_{k} s^{k}}
\]
System function is always rational ODE does not specify ROC! Need additional conditions (e.g. stability, causality) to determine \(h(t)\).

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
例
Consider LTI system with input and output related by
\[
y^{\prime}(t)+3 y(t)=x^{\prime}(t)+x(t)
\]
System function
\[
H(s)=\frac{s+1}{s+3}=1-\frac{2}{s+3}
\]
Two possibilities for ROC: \(\operatorname{Re} s>-3\) and \(\operatorname{Re} s<-3\)

If \(\operatorname{Re} s>-3\), causal and stable,

\[
h(t)=\delta(t)-2 e^{-3 t} u(t)
\]

If \(\operatorname{Re} s<-3\), anticausal and unstable,

\[
h(t)=\delta(t)+2 e^{-3 t} u(-t)
\]

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
例 (cont’d)
Consider LTI system with input and output related by
\[
y^{\prime}(t)+3 y(t)=x^{\prime}(t)+x(t)
\]
If we use Fourier transform, then frequency response is
\[
H(j \omega)=\frac{j \omega+1}{j \omega+3}=1-\frac{2}{j \omega+3}
\]
and
\[
h(t)=\delta(t)-2 e^{-3 t} u(t)
\]
Why only one possibility?

Fourier transform method assumes stability, requiring that ROC of \(H(s)\) contain the imaginary axis, so \(\operatorname{Re} s>-3\)
In general, not applicable to unstable systems

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
例 (cont’d)
Find response to \(x(t)=e^{-4 t} u(t)\).
\[
X(s)=\frac{1}{s+4}, \quad \operatorname{Re} s>-4
\]
Laplace transform for response
\[
Y(s)=H(s) X(s)=\frac{s+1}{s+3} \cdot \frac{1}{s+4}=\frac{-2}{s+3}+\frac{3}{s+4}
\]

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
Two possible ROCs
1 . If \(\operatorname{Re} s>-3\),
\[
y(t)=-2 e^{-3 t} u(t)+3 e^{-4 t} u(t)
\]

If \(-4<\operatorname{Re} s<-3\),

\[
y(t)=2 e^{-3 t} u(-5)+3 e^{-4 t} u(t)
\]

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
例 (cont’d)
Find response to \(x(t)=e^{-3 t} u(t)\).
\[
X(s)=\frac{1}{s+3}, \quad \operatorname{Re} s>-3
\]
Laplace transform for response
\[
Y(s)=H(s) X(s)=\frac{s+1}{s+3} \cdot \frac{1}{s+3}=\frac{1}{s+3}+\frac{-2}{(s+3)^{2}}
\]
Only one possible ROC \(\operatorname{Re} s>-3\)
\[
y(t)=(1-2 t) e^{-3 t} u(t)
\]
For the anticausal and unstable system,
\[
h(t)=\delta(t)+2 e^{-3 t} u(-t)
\]
Can verify directly \(x * h\) is not well-defined.

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
例
The response of an LTI system to the input \(x(t)=e^{-3 t} u(t)\) is
\[
y(t)=\left(e^{-t}-e^{-2 t}\right) u(t)
\]
System function
\[
H(s)=\frac{Y(s)}{X(s)}=\frac{\frac{1}{s+1}-\frac{1}{s+2}}{\frac{1}{s+3}}=\frac{s+3}{s^{2}+3 s+2}, \quad \operatorname{Re} s>-1
\]
By partial fraction expansion
\[
H(s)=\frac{2}{s+1}-\frac{1}{s+2}, \operatorname{Re} s>-1 \Longrightarrow h(t)=\left(2 e^{-t}-e^{-2 t}\right) u(t)
\]
Can be described by the following ODE
\[
\frac{d^{2} y}{d t^{2}}+3 \frac{d y}{d t}+2 y=\frac{d x}{d t}+3 x
\]

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
卷积性质
如果
\[
\begin{array}{ll}
x(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} X(s) & \text { with } \text { ROAC }=R_{1} \\
y(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} Y(s) & \text { with ROAC }=R_{2}
\end{array}
\]
then
\[
(x * y)(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} X(s) Y(s) \quad \text { with ROAC } \supset R_{1} \cap R_{2}
\]
A more precise statement is the following. 定理. 如果 both \(X(s)=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} x(t) e^{-s t} d t\) and \(Y(s)=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} y(t) e^{-s t} d t\) converges absolutely at some \(s=s_{0}\), then the Laplace transform of \(z=x * y\) converges absolutely at \(s=s_{0}\), and
\[
X\left(s_{0}\right) Y\left(s_{0}\right)=Z\left(s_{0}\right)=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} z(t) e^{-s_{0} t} d t
\]

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
卷积性质
证明.
\[
\begin{aligned}
X(s) Y(s) & =\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} x(v)\left[\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} y(\tau) e^{-s(v+\tau)} d v\right] d \tau \\
& =\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} x(v)\left[\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} y(t-v) e^{-s v} d v\right] d t \quad(t=v+\tau) \\
& =\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\left[\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} x(v) y(t-v) d t\right] e^{-s v} d v \quad \text { (Fubini's 定理) }
\end{aligned}
\]
注意： The ROAC of \(\mathcal{L}\{x * y\}\) may be larger than the common ROAC of \(\mathcal{L}\{x\}\) and \(\mathcal{L}\{y\}\).
例. \(X_{1}(s)=\frac{s+1}{(s+2)^{2}}\) 其收敛域为 \(\operatorname{Re} s>-2, X_{2}(s)=\frac{1}{s+1}\) 其收敛域为 Re \(s>-1\), 但是 \(X(s)=X_{1}(s) X_{2}(s)=\frac{1}{(s+2)^{2}}\) with ROAC \(\operatorname{Re} s>-2\), 由于 pole-zero cancellation at \(s=-1\).

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
时域微分性质
如果
\[
x(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} X(s), \quad \text { with } \text { ROC }=R
\]
and \(\lim _{t \rightarrow \pm \infty} x(t) e^{-s t}=0\) for \(s \in R_{0}\), then
\[
\frac{d}{d t} x(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} s X(s), \quad \text { with } \mathrm{ROC} \supset R \cap R_{0}
\]
证明. Integration by parts 则有
\[
\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} x^{\prime}(t) e^{-s t} d t=\left.x(t) e^{-s t}\right|_{-\infty} ^{\infty}+s \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} x(t) e^{-s t} d t=s \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} x(t) e^{-s t} d t
\]
注意： ROC may enlarge or shrink 例. \(x(t)=\left(1-e^{-t}\right) u(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{1}{s(s+1)}\) with ROC = ROAC \(\operatorname{Re} s>0\), and \(x^{\prime}(t)=e^{-t} u(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{1}{s+1}\) with ROC = ROAC \(\operatorname{Re} s>-1\). The 其收敛域 \(\mathcal{L}\left\{x^{\prime}\right\}\) is larger that that of \(\mathcal{L}\{x\}\).

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
时域微分性质
例. Consider \(x(t)=e^{k t} \sin \left(e^{k t}\right)\) with \(k>0\).

对于 \(s=\sigma \in \mathbb{R}, u=e^{k t}\) 则有 (cf. slide 18)

\[
\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} x(t) e^{-s t} d t=\frac{1}{k} \int_{0}^{\infty} \frac{\sin u}{u^{\sigma / k}} d u=\frac{1}{k} \int_{0}^{1} \frac{\sin u}{u^{\sigma / k}} d u+\frac{1}{k} \int_{1}^{\infty} \frac{\sin u}{u^{\sigma / k}} d u
\]

\(\int_{1}^{\infty} \frac{\sin u}{u^{\sigma / k}} d u\) 其收敛域为 \(\operatorname{Re} s>k\) and ROC \(\operatorname{Re} s>0\)
As \(u \downarrow 0, \frac{\sin u}{u^{\sigma / k}} \sim u^{1-\sigma / k}\), so \(\int_{0}^{1} \frac{\sin u}{u^{\sigma / k}} d u\) 其收敛域为 \(\operatorname{Re} s<2 k\)
Thus \(\mathcal{L}\{x\}\) has \(\operatorname{ROC} k<\operatorname{Re} s<2 k\) and \(\operatorname{ROC} 0<\operatorname{Re} s<2 k\).
\(x^{\prime}(t)=k e^{k t} \sin \left(e^{k t}\right)+k e^{2 k t} \cos \left(e^{k t}\right)\). 对于 \(s=\sigma \in \mathbb{R}\),

\[
\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} x^{\prime}(t) e^{-s t} d t=\int_{0}^{\infty} \frac{\sin u+u \cos u}{u^{\sigma / k}} d u
\]
\(\mathcal{L}\left\{x^{\prime}\right\}\) has empty ROAC, and ROC \(k<\operatorname{Re} s<2 k\)

Note \(\lim _{t \rightarrow \pm \infty} x(t) e^{-s t}=0\) fails for \(s\) with \(0<\operatorname{Re} s<k\)

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
时域微分性质
如果 \(x(t)=O\left(e^{a t}\right)\) as \(t \rightarrow+\infty\) and \(x(t)=O\left(e^{b t}\right)\) as \(t \rightarrow-\infty\), then
\[
x(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} X(s), \quad \text { with ROAC containing } a<\operatorname{Re} s<b
\]
and
\[
\frac{d}{d t} x(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} s X(s), \quad \text { with ROC containing } a<\operatorname{Re} s<b
\]
注意： 一般来说, from the absolute convergence of \(\mathcal{L}\{x\}\) at \(s=s_{0}\) we can only conclude the convergence of \(\mathcal{L}\left\{x^{\prime}\right\}\) at \(s=s_{0}\).
注意： We mostly deal with \(x(t)\) of the form \(\sum_{k=0}^{m} p_{k}(t) e^{\alpha_{k} t} u\left( \pm t+\beta_{k}\right)\), 其中 \(p_{k}\) are polynomials. After introducing Laplace transform for singularity functions, we have for such functions,
\[
\frac{d^{n}}{d t^{n}} x(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} s^{n} X(s), \quad \text { with ROC containing } a<\operatorname{Re} s<b
\]

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
\(s\) 域微分性质
如果
\[
x(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} X(s), \quad \operatorname{ROAC} \sigma_{1}<\operatorname{Re} s<\sigma_{2}
\]
then
\[
-t x(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{d}{d s} X(s), \quad \operatorname{ROAC} \sigma_{1}<\operatorname{Re} s<\sigma_{2}
\]
“证明”. D当且仅当erentiating under integral sign (can be justified)
\[
\frac{d}{d s} \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} x(t) e^{-s t} d t=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} x(t) \frac{d}{d s} e^{-s t} d t=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}-t x(t) e^{-s t} d t
\]
例.
\[
e^{-a t} u(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{1}{s+a}, \quad \operatorname{Re} s>-a
\]
\[
t^{n} e^{-a t} u(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow}\left(-\frac{d}{d s}\right)^{n} \frac{1}{s+a}=\frac{n!}{(s+a)^{n+1}}, \quad \operatorname{Re} s>-a
\]
Similarly,
\[
-t^{n} e^{-a t} u(-t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{n!}{(s+a)^{n+1}}, \quad \operatorname{Re} s<-a
\]

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
时域积分性质
如果
\[
x(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} X(s), \quad \text { ROAC }=R
\]
then
\[
\int_{-\infty}^{t} x(\tau) d \tau \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{1}{s} X(s), \quad \text { ROAC } \supset R \cap\{\operatorname{Re} s>0\}
\]
证明. Follows from convolution property and the following
\[
\int_{-\infty}^{t} x(\tau) d \tau=(x * u)(t)
\]
and
\[
u(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{1}{s} \text { with ROAC }=\{\operatorname{Re} s>0\}
\]
注意： This property holds also for Laplace transforms of singularity functions and will be useful computing some Laplace transforms.

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
拉普拉斯逆变换
Recall Laplace transform is related to CTFT by
\[
X(\sigma+j \omega)=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\left\{x(t) e^{-\sigma t}\right\} e^{-j \omega t} d t=\mathcal{F}\left\{x(t) e^{-\sigma t}\right\}
\]
Take the inverse Fourier transform for \(s=\sigma+j \omega \in \mathrm{ROC}\),
\[
x(t) e^{-\sigma t}=\frac{1}{2 \pi} \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} X(\sigma+j \omega) e^{j \omega t} d \omega
\]
so
\[
x(t)=\frac{1}{2 \pi} \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} X(\sigma+j \omega) e^{(\sigma+j \omega) t} d \omega
\]
or
\[
x(t)=\frac{1}{j 2 \pi} \int_{\sigma-j \infty}^{\sigma+j \infty} X(s) e^{s t} d s=\lim _{A \rightarrow \infty} \frac{1}{j 2 \pi} \int_{\sigma-j A}^{\sigma+j A} X(s) e^{s t} d s
\]

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
section: Inverse Transform by Partial Fraction Expansion
text:
Inverse Transform by Partial Fraction Expansion
对于 rational Laplace transform, the inverse transform can be found by partial fraction expansion.
Recall a proper rational function has the following partial fraction expansion
\[
R(s)=\sum_{i=1}^{r} \sum_{k_{i}=1}^{N_{i}} \frac{A_{i, k_{i}}}{\left(s+a_{i}\right)^{k_{i}}}
\]
Also recall
\[
\begin{aligned}
\frac{t^{n-1}}{(n-1)!} e^{-a t} u(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{1}{(s+a)^{n}}, & \operatorname{Re} s>-a \\
-\frac{t^{n-1}}{(n-1)!} e^{-a t} u(-t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{1}{(s+a)^{n}}, & \operatorname{Re} s<-a
\end{aligned}
\]
By linearity, \(\mathcal{L}^{-1}\{R\}\) is a linear combination of terms of the above form, 其中 signs are chosen according to the ROC.

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
例
Consider a rational Laplace transform \(X(s)=\frac{1}{(s+1)(s+2)^{2}}\)
\[
X(s)=\frac{1}{s+1}+\frac{-1}{s+2}+\frac{-1}{(s+2)^{2}}
\]
Two poles at \(s=-1\) and \(s=-2\).

如果 ROC is \(\operatorname{Re} s>-1\)

\[
x(t)=e^{-t} u(t)-(1+t) e^{-2 t} u(t)
\]

如果 ROC is \(\operatorname{Re} s<-2\)

\[
x(t)=-e^{-t} u(-t)+(1+t) e^{-2 t} u(-t)
\]

如果 ROC is \(-2<\operatorname{Re} s<-1\)

\[
x(t)=-e^{-t} u(-t)-(1+t) e^{-2 t} u(t)
\]

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
Inverse Transform by Contour Integration
Suppose \(X(s)\) has finitely many finite isolated singularities \(s_{1}, \ldots, s_{n}\), and ROC is \(-\infty \leq \sigma_{1}<\operatorname{Re} s<\sigma_{2} \leq+\infty\).
The inverse transform is
\[
x(t)=\lim _{r \rightarrow \infty} \frac{1}{j 2 \pi} \int_{\sigma-j r}^{\sigma+j r} X(s) e^{s t} d s
\]
其中 \(\sigma_{1}<\sigma<\sigma_{2}\). 对于 \(t>0\), choose a large semicircle \(C_{r}\) that encloses all \(s_{k}\) with \(\operatorname{Re} s \leq \sigma_{1}\).
如果 \(X(s)\) satisfies \({ }^{1}\) (a shifted and rotated version of) Jordan’s Lemma (slide 6, Lecture 27), Residue 定理 implies 
\[
x(t)=\sum_{k: s_{k} \leq \sigma_{1}} \operatorname{Res}\left[X(s) e^{s t}, s_{k}\right], \quad t>0
\]
\({ }^{1}\) satisfied by proper rational functions

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
Inverse Transform by Contour Integration
Suppose \(X(s)\) has finitely many finite isolated singularities \(s_{1}, \ldots, s_{n}\), and ROC is \(-\infty \leq \sigma_{1}<\operatorname{Re} s<\sigma_{2} \leq+\infty\).
The inverse transform is
\[
x(t)=\lim _{r \rightarrow \infty} \frac{1}{j 2 \pi} \int_{\sigma-j r}^{\sigma+j r} X(s) e^{s t} d s
\]
其中 \(\sigma_{1}<\sigma<\sigma_{2}\). 对于 \(t<0\), choose a large semicircle \(C_{r}\) that encloses all \(s_{k}\) with \(\operatorname{Re} s \geq \sigma_{2}\).
如果 \(X(s)\) satisfies (a shifted and rotated version of) Jordan’s Lemma, Residue 定理 implies
\[
x(t)=-\sum_{k: s_{k} \geq \sigma_{2}} \operatorname{Res}\left[X(s) e^{s t}, s_{k}\right], \quad t<0
\]

Caution. Negative sign 由于 negative orientation of contour.

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
例
Consider a rational Laplace transform \(X(s)=\frac{1}{(s+1)(s+2)^{2}}\)
\[
\begin{gathered}
\operatorname{Res}\left[X(s) e^{s t},-1\right]=\left.\frac{e^{s t}}{(s+2)^{2}}\right|_{s=-1}=e^{-t} \\
\operatorname{Res}\left[X(s) e^{s t},-2\right]=\left[\frac{d}{d s} \frac{e^{s t}}{s+1}\right]_{s=-2}=-(1+t) e^{-2 t}
\end{gathered}
\]

如果 ROC is \(\operatorname{Re} s>-1\), then \(\sigma_{1}=-1, \sigma_{2}=+\infty\).

对于 \(t>0\),
\[
x(t)=\sum_{k: \operatorname{Re} s_{k} \leq-1} \operatorname{Res}\left[X(s) e^{s t}, s_{k}\right]=e^{-t}-(1+t) e^{-2 t}
\]
对于 \(t<0\),
\[
x(t)=-\sum_{k: \operatorname{Re} s_{k} \geq+\infty} \operatorname{Res}\left[X(s) e^{s t}, s_{k}\right]=0
\]

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
例 (cont’d)
Consider a rational Laplace transform \(X(s)=\frac{1}{(s+1)(s+2)^{2}}\)
\[
\begin{gathered}
\operatorname{Res}\left[X(s) e^{s t},-1\right]=\left.\frac{e^{s t}}{(s+2)^{2}}\right|_{s=-1}=e^{-t} \\
\operatorname{Res}\left[X(s) e^{s t},-2\right]=\left[\frac{d}{d s} \frac{e^{s t}}{s+1}\right]_{s=-2}=-(1+t) e^{-2 t}
\end{gathered}
\]

如果 ROC is \(\operatorname{Re} s<-2\), then \(\sigma_{1}=-\infty, \sigma_{2}=-2\).

对于 \(t>0\),
\[
x(t)=\sum_{k: \operatorname{Re} s_{k} \leq-\infty} \operatorname{Res}\left[X(s) e^{s t}, s_{k}\right]=0
\]
对于 \(t<0\),
\[
x(t)=-\sum_{k: \operatorname{Re} s_{k} \geq-2} \operatorname{Res}\left[X(s) e^{s t}, s_{k}\right]=-e^{-t}+(1+t) e^{-2 t}
\]

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
例 (cont’d)
Consider a rational Laplace transform \(X(s)=\frac{1}{(s+1)(s+2)^{2}}\)
\[
\begin{gathered}
\operatorname{Res}\left[X(s) e^{s t},-1\right]=\left.\frac{e^{s t}}{(s+2)^{2}}\right|_{s=-1}=e^{-t} \\
\operatorname{Res}\left[X(s) e^{s t},-2\right]=\left[\frac{d}{d s} \frac{e^{s t}}{s+1}\right]_{s=-2}=-(1+t) e^{-2 t}
\end{gathered}
\]

如果 ROC is \(-2<\operatorname{Re} s<-1\), then \(\sigma_{1}=-2, \sigma_{2}=-1\).

对于 \(t>0\),
\[
x(t)=\sum_{k: \operatorname{Re} s_{k} \leq-2} \operatorname{Res}\left[X(s) e^{s t}, s_{k}\right]=-(1+t) e^{-2 t}
\]
对于 \(t<0\),
\[
x(t)=-\sum_{k: \operatorname{Re} s_{k} \geq-1} \operatorname{Res}\left[X(s) e^{s t}, s_{k}\right]=-e^{-t}
\]

text:
奇异函数的拉普拉斯变换
The properties of Laplace transforms discussed previously still holds for this generalization.
例. The property of time d当且仅当erentiation is equivalent to the convolution property involving \(\delta^{\prime}\).
\[
\mathcal{L}\left\{x^{\prime}\right\}=\mathcal{L}\left\{x * \delta^{\prime}\right\}=\mathcal{L}\{x\} \mathcal{L}\left\{\delta^{\prime}\right\}=s \mathcal{L}\{x\}
\]
例.    \(X_{2}(s)=-\frac{4}{T}+\frac{2}{T} e^{-s \frac{T}{2}}+\frac{2}{T} e^{s \frac{T}{2}}=\frac{8}{T} \sinh ^{2}\left(\frac{s T}{4}\right) \Longrightarrow X(s)=\frac{X_{2}(s)}{s^{2}}\)

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
拉普拉斯逆变换
Recall a rational function can be written as the sum of a polynomial and a proper rational function
\[
R(s)=\sum_{k=1}^{n} a_{k} s^{k}+R_{1}(s)
\]
Thus
\[
\mathcal{L}^{-1}\{R\}=\sum_{k=1}^{n} a_{k} \delta^{(k)}(t)+\mathcal{L}^{-1}\left\{R_{1}\right\}
\]
其中 \(\mathcal{L}^{-1}\left\{R_{1}\right\}\) can be found by partial fraction expansion or contour integration.
例. \(X(s)=\frac{s(s+2)}{s+3}=s-1+\frac{3}{s+3}\) with \(\operatorname{ROC} \operatorname{Re} s>-3\), so
\[
x(t)=\delta^{\prime}(t)-\delta(t)+3 e^{-3 t} u(t)
\]

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
CT System Function
回顾：连续时间 LTI 系统对输入的响应为 \(x(t)\) is
\[
y(t)=(x * h)(t)
\]
其中 \(h\) is the impulse response of the system. 如果 \(x\) and \(h\) have Laplace transforms, the convolution property implies
\[
Y(s)=X(s) H(s)
\]
in their common \(\mathrm{ROC}^{2}\). 如果 the ROC has a nonempty interior point, the system function (aka transfer function) \(H(s)\) uniquely determines \(h\) and hence system properties through the inverse Laplace transform (this can be proved, 但是 we will not do so).
1 ## 因果性
Recall \(h\) is right-sided 当且仅当 the 其收敛域 \(H(s)\) is a right half-plane, causal \(\Longrightarrow \mathrm{ROC}\) is a right half-plane
Caution. The converse is not true. 例. Consider \(H(s)=\frac{e^{s}}{s+1}\) with \(\operatorname{ROC} \operatorname{Re} s>-1\). By the time-shift property,
\[
h(t)=e^{-(t+1)} u(t+1)
\]
which is not causal.

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
因果性
An LTI system with rational system function \(H(s)\) 是因果的 当且仅当 the ROC is the right half-plane to the rightmost pole.
证明. Recall for a rational system function,
\[
H(s)=\sum_{k=1}^{n} a_{k} s^{k}+\sum_{i=1}^{r} \sum_{k_{i}=1}^{N_{i}} \frac{A_{i, k_{i}}}{\left(s+a_{i}\right)^{k_{i}}}, \quad \operatorname{Re} s>\max _{i} \operatorname{Re}\left(-a_{i}\right)
\]
SO
\[
h(t)=\sum_{k=1}^{n} a_{k} \delta^{(k)}(t)+\sum_{i=1}^{r} \sum_{k_{i}=1}^{N_{i}} \frac{A_{i, k_{i}}}{\left(k_{i}-1\right)!} t^{k_{i}-1} e^{-a_{i} t} u(t)
\]
which 是因果的. (Can also prove by contour integration.) 例. \(h(t)=e^{-t} u(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} H(s)=\frac{1}{s+1}\) with \(\operatorname{Re} s>-1\), causal. 例. \(h(t)=e^{-|t|} \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} H(s)=\frac{-2}{s^{2}-1}\) with \(-1<\operatorname{Re} s<1\), noncausal.

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
稳定性
Recall an LTI system is stable 当且仅当 its impulse response \(h \in L_{1}\), i.e.
\[
\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}|h(t)| d t<\infty
\]
i.e. \(H(s)\) converges absolutely on the imaginary axis \(\operatorname{Re} s=0\), so its \(\operatorname{ROC}-\infty \leq \sigma_{1}<\operatorname{Re} s<\sigma_{2} \leq \infty\) must satisfy \(\sigma_{1}<0<\sigma_{2}\).
stable \(\Longleftrightarrow\) ROC includes the imaginary axis
A causal LTI system with rational system function \(H(s)\) is stable 当且仅当 all its poles have negative real parts.
例. A causal system with \(H(s)=\frac{1}{s+a}\) is stable 当且仅当 \(\operatorname{Re} a>0\) 例. A system with \(H(s)=\frac{1}{s+a}\) 其中 \(\operatorname{Re} a<0\) and ROC \(\operatorname{Re} s<-\operatorname{Re} a\) is also stable, 但是 it is noncausal.

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
例
Consider the system function
\[
H(s)=\frac{1}{s-2}-\frac{1}{s+1}
\]
There are two poles \(p_{1}=-1\) and \(p_{2}=2\).

Re \(s<-1\), noncausal, unstable

\[
h_{1}(t)=-e^{2 t} u(-t)+e^{-t} u(-t)
\]
 2. \(-1<\operatorname{Re} s<2\), noncausal, stable
\[
h_{2}(t)=-e^{2 t} u(-t)-e^{-t} u(t)
\]

\(\operatorname{Re} s>2\), causal, unstable

\[
h_{3}(t)=e^{2 t} u(t)-e^{-t} u(t)
\]

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
线性常系数微分方程
LTI system with input and output related by
\[
\sum_{k=0}^{N} a_{k} \frac{d^{k} y}{d t^{k}}=\sum_{k=0}^{M} b_{k} \frac{d^{k} x}{d t^{k}}
\]
Take Laplace transform of both sides
\[
\sum_{k=0}^{N} a_{k} s^{k} Y(s)=\sum_{k=0}^{M} b_{k} s^{k} X(s)
\]
so
\[
H(s)=\frac{Y(s)}{X(s)}=\frac{\sum_{k=0}^{M} b_{k} s^{k}}{\sum_{k=0}^{N} a_{k} s^{k}}
\]
System function is always rational ODE does not specify ROC! Need additional conditions (e.g. stability, causality) to determine \(h(t)\).

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
例
Consider LTI system with input and output related by
\[
y^{\prime}(t)+3 y(t)=x^{\prime}(t)+x(t)
\]
System function
\[
H(s)=\frac{s+1}{s+3}=1-\frac{2}{s+3}
\]
Two possibilities for ROC: \(\operatorname{Re} s>-3\) and \(\operatorname{Re} s<-3\)

如果 \(\operatorname{Re} s>-3\), causal and stable,

\[
h(t)=\delta(t)-2 e^{-3 t} u(t)
\]

如果 \(\operatorname{Re} s<-3\), anticausal and unstable,

\[
h(t)=\delta(t)+2 e^{-3 t} u(-t)
\]

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
例 (cont’d)
Consider LTI system with input and output related by
\[
y^{\prime}(t)+3 y(t)=x^{\prime}(t)+x(t)
\]
如果 we use Fourier transform, then frequency response is
\[
H(j \omega)=\frac{j \omega+1}{j \omega+3}=1-\frac{2}{j \omega+3}
\]
and
\[
h(t)=\delta(t)-2 e^{-3 t} u(t)
\]
Why only one possibility?

Fourier transform method assumes stability, requiring that 其收敛域 \(H(s)\) contain the imaginary axis, so \(\operatorname{Re} s>-3\)
一般来说, not applicable to unstable systems

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
例 (cont’d)
Find response to \(x(t)=e^{-4 t} u(t)\).
\[
X(s)=\frac{1}{s+4}, \quad \operatorname{Re} s>-4
\]
Laplace transform for response
\[
Y(s)=H(s) X(s)=\frac{s+1}{s+3} \cdot \frac{1}{s+4}=\frac{-2}{s+3}+\frac{3}{s+4}
\]

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
Two possible ROCs
1 . 如果 \(\operatorname{Re} s>-3\),
\[
y(t)=-2 e^{-3 t} u(t)+3 e^{-4 t} u(t)
\]

如果 \(-4<\operatorname{Re} s<-3\),

\[
y(t)=2 e^{-3 t} u(-5)+3 e^{-4 t} u(t)
\]

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
例 (cont’d)
Find response to \(x(t)=e^{-3 t} u(t)\).
\[
X(s)=\frac{1}{s+3}, \quad \operatorname{Re} s>-3
\]
Laplace transform for response
\[
Y(s)=H(s) X(s)=\frac{s+1}{s+3} \cdot \frac{1}{s+3}=\frac{1}{s+3}+\frac{-2}{(s+3)^{2}}
\]
Only one possible ROC \(\operatorname{Re} s>-3\)
\[
y(t)=(1-2 t) e^{-3 t} u(t)
\]
对于 the anticausal and unstable system,
\[
h(t)=\delta(t)+2 e^{-3 t} u(-t)
\]
Can verify directly \(x * h\) is not well-defined.

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
例
The response of an LTI system to the input \(x(t)=e^{-3 t} u(t)\) is
\[
y(t)=\left(e^{-t}-e^{-2 t}\right) u(t)
\]
System function
\[
H(s)=\frac{Y(s)}{X(s)}=\frac{\frac{1}{s+1}-\frac{1}{s+2}}{\frac{1}{s+3}}=\frac{s+3}{s^{2}+3 s+2}, \quad \operatorname{Re} s>-1
\]
By partial fraction expansion
\[
H(s)=\frac{2}{s+1}-\frac{1}{s+2}, \operatorname{Re} s>-1 \Longrightarrow h(t)=\left(2 e^{-t}-e^{-2 t}\right) u(t)
\]
Can be described by the following ODE
\[
\frac{d^{2} y}{d t^{2}}+3 \frac{d y}{d t}+2 y=\frac{d x}{d t}+3 x
\]

h=?

text:

Equivalent description by ODE

with initial rest condition.

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
例
Causal LTI systems with system function
\[
H(s)=\frac{1}{(s+1)(s+2)}=\frac{1}{s^{2}+3 s+2}
\]
Equivalent description by d当且仅当erent equation
\[

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第31讲（中文版）
text:
单边拉普拉斯变换
回顾： the (双边) Laplace transform of a CT signal \(x\)
\[
X(s)=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} x(t) e^{-s t} d t
\]
The 单边 Laplace transform of \(x\) is
\[
X(s)=\int_{0_{-}}^{\infty} x(t) e^{-s t} d t
\]
also denoted
\[
\mathcal{X}=\mathcal{U} \mathcal{L}\{x\}, \quad x(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{U L}}{\longleftrightarrow} \mathcal{X}(s)
\]
收敛域 of \(X\) is always a right half-plane 注意： Information about \(x(t)\) at \(t<0\) is lost in \(x\). 注意： \(\mathcal{L}\{x\}=\mathcal{U} \mathcal{L}\{x\}\) iff \(x(t)\) is causal, i.e. \(x(t)=0\) for \(t<0\)

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第31讲（中文版）
text:
例子
The calculation of 单边 Laplace transforms is almost the same as for 双边 Laplace transforms.
例. \(x_{1}(t)=e^{-a t} u(t)\),
\[
X_{1}(s)=X_{1}(s)=\frac{1}{s+a}, \quad \operatorname{Re} s>-\operatorname{Re} a
\]
例. \(x_{2}(t)=e^{-a(t+1)} u(t+1)=x_{1}(t+1)\),
\[
\begin{array}{cl}
\text { 双边 } & X_{2}(s)=e^{s} X_{1}(s)=\frac{e^{s}}{s+a}, \quad \operatorname{Re} s>-\operatorname{Re} a \\
\text { 单边 } & X_{2}(s)=\int_{0}^{\infty} e^{-a(t+1)} e^{-s t} d t=\frac{e^{-a}}{s+a}, \operatorname{Re} s>-\operatorname{Re} a
\end{array}
\]
注意： \(X_{2} \neq X_{2}\), since \(x_{2}\) is noncausal. 注意： \(X_{2} \neq e^{s} X_{1}\), time-shift property fails for 单边 transform.

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第31讲（中文版）
text:
例子
The calculation of 单边 Laplace transforms is almost the same as for 双边 Laplace transforms.
例. \(x_{3}(t)=e^{-a|t|}\) 其 \(\operatorname{Re} a>0\)
\[
\begin{aligned}
\text { 双边 } & X_{3}(t)=\frac{-2 a}{s^{2}-a^{2}}, \quad-\operatorname{Re} a<\operatorname{Re} s<\operatorname{Re} a \\
\text { 单边 } & X_{3}(s)=\frac{1}{s+a}, \quad \operatorname{Re} s>-\operatorname{Re} a
\end{aligned}
\]
注意： \(X_{3} \neq X_{1}\), since \(x_{3} \neq x_{1}\) 注意： \(X_{3}=X_{1}\), since \(x_{3}\) and \(x_{1}\) differ only for \(t<0\) 例. \(x(t)=\delta(t)+2 \delta^{\prime}(t)+e^{t} u(t)\)
\[
X(s)=X(s)=1+2 s+\frac{1}{s-1}, \quad \operatorname{Re} s>1
\]
注意： The lower limit of integration is \(0_{-}\)so \(\delta\) and \(\delta^{\prime}\) contribute to \(\mathcal{X}\)

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第31讲（中文版）
text:
例子
The calculation of inverse 单边 Laplace transforms is the same as for 双边 Laplace transforms, but we can only recover \(x(t)\) for \(t \geq 0\) !
例. Given 单边 Laplace transform
\[
X(s)=\frac{1}{(s+1)(s+2)}=\frac{1}{s+1}-\frac{1}{s+2}
\]
the only possibility for 收敛域 is \(\operatorname{Re} s>-1\). Thus
\[
x(t)=e^{-t}-e^{-2 t}, \quad t \geq 0
\]
X provides no information about \(x(t)\) for \(t<0\) 例. \(\mathfrak{X}(s)=\frac{s^{2}-3}{s+2}=-2+s+\frac{1}{s+2}\). The 收敛域 must be \(\operatorname{Re} s>-2\), and
\[
x(t)=-2 \delta(t)+\delta^{\prime}(t)+e^{-2 t}, \quad t \geq 0
\]

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第31讲（中文版）
section: Convolution Property of 单边拉普拉斯变换
text:
Convolution Property of 单边拉普拉斯变换
若 \(x(t)=y(t)=0\) for \(t<0\), 则
\[
(x * y)(t) \stackrel{u \mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} X(s) y(s), \quad \text { 收敛域 } \supset \operatorname{收敛域}_{x} \cap \operatorname{收敛域}_{y}
\]
证明. Note \((x * y)(t)=0\) for \(t<0\).
\[
\mathcal{U} \mathcal{L}\{x * y\}=\mathcal{L}\{x * y\}=\mathcal{L}\{x\} \mathcal{L}\{y\}=\mathcal{U} \mathcal{L}\{x\} \mathcal{U} \mathcal{L}\{y\}
\]
Caution. The assumption \(x(t)=y(t)=0\) for \(t<0\) is important! 例. \(x(t)=\delta(t)-\delta(t-1), y(t)=\delta(t+1)\),
\[
X(s)=1-e^{-s}, \quad Y(s)=0,
\]
Note \((x * y)(t)=\delta(t+1)-\delta(t)\), and
\[
\mathcal{U} \mathcal{L}\{x * y\}=-1 \neq \mathcal{X}(s) \mathcal{Y}(s)
\]

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第31讲（中文版）
text:
时域积分性质
若
\[
x(t) \stackrel{\varkappa L}{\longleftrightarrow} X(s), \quad \text { 其 } \text { 收敛域 }=R
\]
则
\[
\int_{0_{-}}^{t} x(\tau) d \tau \stackrel{u \mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{1}{s} \mathcal{X}(s), \quad \text { 其 收敛域 } \supset R \cap\{\operatorname{Re} s>0\}
\]
证明. Apply the convolution property to \(\tilde{x} * u\), where
\[
\tilde{x}(t)= \begin{cases}x(t), & t \geq 0 \\ 0, & t<0\end{cases}
\]
例. \(x(t)=\delta(t), X(s)=1\).
\[
\int_{0_{-}}^{t} x(\tau) d \tau=u(t) \stackrel{u \mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{1}{s}, \quad \operatorname{Re} s>0
\]

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第31讲（中文版）
text:
时域微分性质
若
\[
x(t) \stackrel{u \Sigma}{\longleftrightarrow} X(s), \quad \text { 其 } \mathrm{收敛域}=R
\]
and \(\lim _{t \rightarrow+\infty} x(t) e^{-s t}=0\) for \(s \in R_{0}\), 则
\[
\frac{d}{d t} x(t) \stackrel{u \mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} s \mathcal{X}(s)-x\left(0_{-}\right), \quad \text { 其 } \mathrm{收敛域} \supset R \cap R_{0}
\]
注意： \(R_{0} \supset\) 收敛域 of \(X(s)\) (also true for 双边 Laplace transform) 证明. Use integration by parts
\[
\int_{0_{-}}^{\infty} x^{\prime}(t) e^{-s t} d t=\left.x(t) e^{-s t}\right|_{t=0_{-}} ^{\infty}+s \int_{0_{-}}^{\infty} x(t) e^{-s t} d t=-x\left(0_{-}\right)+s \mathfrak{X}(s)
\]
注意： Had we used the definition \(X(s)=\int_{0_{+}}^{\infty} x(t) e^{-s t} d t\), we would have \(\frac{d}{d t} x(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L} \mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} s \mathcal{X}(s)-x\left(0_{+}\right)\)

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第31讲（中文版）
text:
时域微分性质
例. \(x(t)=e^{-t}, \mathcal{X}(s)=\frac{1}{s+1}\) 其 收敛域 Re \(s>-1\). By the differentiation property,
\[
x^{\prime}(t) \stackrel{u \mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{s}{s+1}-1=-\frac{1}{s+1}, \quad \operatorname{收敛域} \supset\{\operatorname{Re} s>-1\}
\]
By direct calculation,
\[
x^{\prime}(t)=-e^{-t} \stackrel{u \mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow}=-\frac{1}{s+1}, \quad \operatorname{收敛域}=\operatorname{收敛域}=\{\operatorname{Re} s>-1\}
\]
例. \(x(t)=e^{-t} u(t), X(s)=\frac{1}{s+1}\) 其 收敛域 \(\operatorname{Re} s>-1\). By the differentiation property,
\[
x^{\prime}(t) \longleftrightarrow \frac{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{s}{s+1}, \quad \operatorname{收敛域} \supset\{\operatorname{Re} s>-1\}
\]
By direct calculation, \(x^{\prime}(t)=\delta(t)-e^{-t} u(t)\), and
\[
\mathcal{U} \mathcal{L}\left\{x^{\prime}\right\}=-\frac{1}{s+1}+1=\frac{s}{s+1}, \quad \mathrm{收敛域}=\mathrm{收敛域}=\{\operatorname{Re} s>-1\}
\]

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第31讲（中文版）
text:
时域微分性质
Under appropriate conditions, e.g. \(x^{(k)}(t)=O\left(e^{\gamma t}\right)\), we can extend the differentiation property to higher derivatives,
\[
x^{(n)}(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{U}}{\longleftrightarrow} s^{n} \mathfrak{X}(s)-\sum_{k=0}^{n-1} s^{n-1-k} x^{(k)}\left(0_{-}\right)
\]
Since solutions to constant coefficient ODEs is of the form
\[
x(t)=\sum_{k=1}^{n} p_{i}(t) e^{a_{i} t}
\]
where \(p_{i}\) are polynomials, the above condition is satisfied. Unilateral Laplace transform is useful for solving ODEs 其 nonzero initial condtions.

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第31讲（中文版）
text:
初值定理
定理. 若 the 单边 Laplace transform \(\mathcal{X}(s)\) of \(x(t)\) is a proper rational function, 则
\[
x\left(0_{+}\right)=\lim _{s \rightarrow \infty} s \mathfrak{X}(s)
\]
证明. \(X(s)\) has partial fraction expansion,
\[
\begin{gathered}
X(s)=\sum_{i=1}^{r} \sum_{k_{i}=1}^{N_{i}} \frac{A_{i, k_{i}}}{\left(s+a_{i}\right)^{k_{i}}} \\
x(t)=\sum_{i=1}^{r} \sum_{k_{i}=1}^{N_{i}} \frac{A_{i, k_{i}} t^{k_{i}-1}}{\left(k_{i}-1\right)!} e^{-a_{i} t}, \quad t \geq 0 \\
x\left(0_{+}\right)=\sum_{i=1}^{r} A_{i, 1}=\lim _{s \rightarrow \infty} \sum_{i=1}^{r} \sum_{k_{i}=1}^{N_{i}} \frac{A_{i, k_{i}} s}{\left(s+a_{i}\right)^{k_{i}}}=\lim _{s \rightarrow \infty} s \mathcal{X}(s)
\end{gathered}
\]
例. \(x(t)=2 e^{-t}+e^{-2 t}, \mathcal{X}(s)=\frac{3 s+5}{s^{2}+3 s+2}, x\left(0_{+}\right)=\lim _{s \rightarrow \infty} s \mathfrak{X}(s)=3\).

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第31讲（中文版）
text:
初值定理
若 \(\mathcal{X}(s)\) is rational but not proper, 则
\[
\mathfrak{X}(s)=\sum_{k=0}^{n} a_{k} s^{k}+\mathfrak{X}_{1}(s)
\]
where \(X_{1}(s)\) is a proper rational function. Taking inverse transform,
\[
x(t)=\sum_{k=0}^{n} a_{k} \delta^{(k)}(t)+x_{1}(t)
\]
So
\[
x\left(0_{+}\right)=x_{1}\left(0_{+}\right)=\lim _{s \rightarrow \infty} s \mathcal{X}_{1}(s)
\]
例. \(x(t)=\delta(t)+2 e^{-t}, X(s)=1+\frac{2}{s+1}=\frac{s+3}{s+1}\),
\[
x\left(0_{+}\right)=2=\lim _{s \rightarrow \infty} \frac{2 s}{s+1} \neq \lim _{s \rightarrow \infty} s \mathfrak{X}(s)
\]

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第31讲（中文版）
text:
例
Suppose a CT LTI system has the following properties.

The system is causal
The system function \(H(s)\) is a proper rational function and has only two poles, at \(s=-2\) and \(s=-4\).
For input \(x(t)=1\), the output is \(y(t)=0\)
The impulse response satisfies \(h\left(0_{+}\right)=4\)

Determine the system function \(H(s)\). 解. By 1 and 2
\[
H(s)=\frac{a s+b}{(s+2)(s+4)}, \quad \operatorname{Re} s>-2
\]
By 3, \(H(0)=0\), so \(b=0\). By 4, \(\lim _{s \rightarrow \infty} s H(s)=4\), so \(a=4\), and
\[
H(s)=\frac{4 s}{(s+2)(s+4)}, \quad \operatorname{Re} s>-2
\]

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第31讲（中文版）
text:
终值定理
定理. Suppose \(x(t)\) does not contain \(\delta\) or its derivatives for \(t \geq 0\). 若 \(X(s)\) converges for real \(s>0\) and the \(x(t)\) has a finite limit as \(t \rightarrow+\infty\), 则
\[
\lim _{t \rightarrow+\infty} x(t)=\lim _{s \rightarrow 0_{+}} s X(s)
\]
证明. Since \(A \triangleq \lim _{t \rightarrow+\infty} x(t)\) exists, \(x(t)\) is bounded on \((0,+\infty)\), i.e. \(|x(t)| \leq M\). For any \(\epsilon>0, \exists T\) s.t. \(|x(t)-A|<\epsilon\) for \(t \geq T\). For \(s>0\),
\[
s \mathfrak{X}(s)-A=s \int_{0}^{\infty}[x(t)-A] e^{-s t} d t
\]
\[
|s \mathcal{X}(s)-A| \leq s\left(\int_{0}^{T}+\int_{T}^{\infty}\right)|x(t)-A| e^{-s t} d t=I_{1}+I_{2}
\]
where \(I_{1} \leq s T(M+A)\) and \(I_{2} \leq \epsilon s \int_{T}^{\infty} e^{-s t} d t \leq \epsilon s \int_{0}^{\infty} e^{-s t} d t=\epsilon\).
\[
\lim _{s \rightarrow 0_{+}}|s \mathcal{X}(s)-A| \leq \epsilon \Longrightarrow \lim _{s \rightarrow 0_{+}}|s \mathcal{X}(s)-A|=0 \Longrightarrow \lim _{s \rightarrow 0_{+}} s \mathcal{X}(s)=A
\]

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第31讲（中文版）
text:
终值定理
例. \(x(t)=2+3 e^{-t}+e^{-2 t}\),
\[
\mathcal{X}(s)=\frac{2}{s}+\frac{3}{s+1}+\frac{1}{s+2}, \quad \operatorname{Re} s>0
\]
Check
\[
\lim _{s \rightarrow 0_{+}} s \mathfrak{X}(s)=2=\lim _{t \rightarrow+\infty} x(t)
\]
The Final Values 定理 can be extended to allow finitely many \(\delta\) and its derivatives in \(x(t)\) on the positive real axis. We can rewrite \(x(t)\) as
\[
\begin{gathered}
x(t)=x_{1}(t)+\sum_{i=1}^{n} a_{i} \delta^{\left(k_{i}\right)}\left(t-t_{i}\right) \stackrel{\mathcal{U L}}{\longleftrightarrow} \mathcal{X}(s)=\mathcal{X}_{1}(s)+\sum_{i=1}^{n} a_{i} s^{k_{i}} e^{-s t_{i}} \\
\lim _{t \rightarrow+\infty} x(t)=\lim _{t \rightarrow+\infty} x_{1}(t)=\lim _{s \rightarrow 0_{+}} s \mathcal{X}_{1}(s)=\lim _{s \rightarrow 0_{+}} s \mathcal{X}(s)
\end{gathered}
\]
例. \(x(t)=\delta(t)+2, \mathcal{X}(s)=\frac{1}{s}+1, x(+\infty)=2=\lim _{s \rightarrow 0_{+}} s \mathcal{X}(s)\).

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第31讲（中文版）
text:
线性常系数微分方程
Consider ODE
\[
\sum_{k=0}^{N} a_{k} \frac{d^{k} y}{d t^{k}}=\sum_{k=0}^{M} b_{k} \frac{d^{k} x}{d t^{k}}
\]
其 initial condition \(y^{(k)}\left(0_{-}\right), k=0,1, \ldots, N-1\), and causal input, i.e. \(x(t)=0\) for \(t<0\).
Take 单边 Laplace transform of both sides
\[
\sum_{k=0}^{N} a_{k}\left[s^{k} \mathcal{Y}(s)-\sum_{\ell=0}^{k-1} s^{k-1-\ell} y^{(\ell)}\left(0_{-}\right)\right]=\sum_{k=0}^{M} b_{k} s^{k} \mathcal{X}(s)
\]
so
\[
y(s)=\underbrace{\frac{\sum_{k=0}^{M} b_{k} s^{k}}{\sum_{k=0}^{N} a_{k} s^{k}} \mathfrak{X}(s)}_{\text {zero-state response }}+\underbrace{\frac{\sum_{k=0}^{N} a_{k} \sum_{\ell=0}^{k-1} s^{k-1-\ell} y^{(\ell)}\left(0_{-}\right)}{\sum_{k=0}^{N} a_{k} s^{k}}}_{\text {zero-input response }}
\]

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第31讲（中文版）
text: 例

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第31讲（中文版）
text:
Consider ODE
\[
y^{\prime \prime}(t)+3 y^{\prime}(t)+2 y(t)=2 x^{\prime}(t)+6 x(t)
\]
其 initial condition \(y\left(0_{-}\right)=c_{0}, y^{\prime}\left(0_{-}\right)=c_{1}\) and \(x(t)=e^{-t} u(t)\). Take 单边 Laplace transform of both sides
\[
\left[s^{2} y(s)-s c_{0}-c_{1}\right]+3\left[s y(s)-c_{0}\right]+2 y(s)=2 s \mathcal{X}(s)+6 \mathcal{X}(s)=\frac{2 s+6}{s+1}
\]
SO
\[
\begin{aligned}
y(s) & =\frac{2 s+6}{\left(s^{2}+3 s+2\right)(s+1)}+\frac{c_{0} s+\left(3 c_{0}+c_{1}\right)}{s^{2}+3 s+2} \\
& =\underbrace{\frac{2 s+6}{(s+1)^{2}(s+2)}}_{\text {zero-state response }}+\underbrace{\frac{c_{0} s+\left(3 c_{0}+c_{1}\right)}{(s+1)(s+2)}}_{\text {zero-input response }}
\end{aligned}
\]

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第31讲（中文版）
text:
例 (cont’d)
Zero-state response
\[
y_{z s}(s)=\frac{2 s+6}{(s+1)^{2}(s+2)}, \quad \operatorname{Re} s>-1
\]
For \(t \geq 0\),
\[
\begin{aligned}
y_{z s}(t) & =\operatorname{Res}\left[y_{z i} e^{s t},-2\right]+\operatorname{Res}\left[y_{z i} e^{s t},-1\right] \\
& =\left.\frac{(2 s+6) e^{s t}}{(s+1)^{2}}\right|_{s=-2}+\left[\frac{d}{d s} \frac{(2 s+6) e^{s t}}{s+2}\right]_{s=-1}=2 e^{-2 t}+(4 t-2) e^{-t}
\end{aligned}
\]
Zero-input response
\[
\begin{aligned}
& y_{z i}(s)=\frac{c_{0} s+\left(3 c_{0}+c_{1}\right)}{(s+1)(s+2)}, \quad \operatorname{Re} s>-1 \\
& \begin{aligned}
y_{z i}(t) & =\operatorname{Res}\left[y_{z s} s t,-2\right]+\operatorname{Res}\left[y_{z s} e^{s t},-1\right] \\
& =\left(2 c_{0}+c_{1}\right) e^{-t}-\left(c_{0}+c_{1}\right) e^{-2 t}, \quad t \geq 0
\end{aligned}
\end{aligned}
\]

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
卷积性质
If
\[
\begin{array}{ll}
x(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} X(s) & \text { with } \text { ROAC }=R_{1} \\
y(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} Y(s) & \text { with ROAC }=R_{2}
\end{array}
\]
则
\[
(x * y)(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} X(s) Y(s) \quad \text { with ROAC } \supset R_{1} \cap R_{2}
\]
A more prec为e statement 为 the following. 定理： 如果both \(X(s)=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} x(t) e^{-s t} d t\) and \(Y(s)=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} y(t) e^{-s t} d t\) converges absolutely at some \(s=s_{0}\), 则 the Laplace transform of \(z=x * y\) converges absolutely at \(s=s_{0}\), and
\[
X\left(s_{0}\right) Y\left(s_{0}\right)=Z\left(s_{0}\right)=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} z(t) e^{-s_{0} t} d t
\]

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
卷积性质
证明.
\[
\begin{aligned}
X(s) Y(s) & =\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} x(v)\left[\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} y(\tau) e^{-s(v+\tau)} d v\right] d \tau \\
& =\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} x(v)\left[\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} y(t-v) e^{-s v} d v\right] d t \quad(t=v+\tau) \\
& =\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\left[\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} x(v) y(t-v) d t\right] e^{-s v} d v \quad \text { (Fubini's Theorem) }
\end{aligned}
\]
注意： The ROAC of \(\mathcal{L}\{x * y\}\) may be larger than the common ROAC of \(\mathcal{L}\{x\}\) and \(\mathcal{L}\{y\}\).
例. \(X_{1}(s)=\frac{s+1}{(s+2)^{2}}\) has ROAC \(\operatorname{Re} s>-2, X_{2}(s)=\frac{1}{s+1}\) has ROAC Re \(s>-1\), but \(X(s)=X_{1}(s) X_{2}(s)=\frac{1}{(s+2)^{2}}\) with ROAC \(\operatorname{Re} s>-2\), due to pole-zero cancellation at \(s=-1\).

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
时域微分性质
If
\[
x(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} X(s), \quad \text { with } \text { ROC }=R
\]
and \(\lim _{t \rightarrow \pm \infty} x(t) e^{-s t}=0\) for \(s \in R_{0}\), 则
\[
\frac{d}{d t} x(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} s X(s), \quad \text { with } \mathrm{ROC} \supset R \cap R_{0}
\]
证明. Integration by parts 得到
\[
\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} x^{\prime}(t) e^{-s t} d t=\left.x(t) e^{-s t}\right|_{-\infty} ^{\infty}+s \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} x(t) e^{-s t} d t=s \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} x(t) e^{-s t} d t
\]
注意： ROC may enlarge or shrink 例. \(x(t)=\left(1-e^{-t}\right) u(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{1}{s(s+1)}\) with ROC = ROAC \(\operatorname{Re} s>0\), and \(x^{\prime}(t)=e^{-t} u(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{1}{s+1}\) with ROC = ROAC \(\operatorname{Re} s>-1\). The ROC of \(\mathcal{L}\left\{x^{\prime}\right\}\) 为 larger that that of \(\mathcal{L}\{x\}\).

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
时域微分性质
例. Consider \(x(t)=e^{k t} \sin \left(e^{k t}\right)\) with \(k>0\).

对于\(s=\sigma \in \mathbb{R}, u=e^{k t}\) 得到 (cf. slide 18)

\[
\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} x(t) e^{-s t} d t=\frac{1}{k} \int_{0}^{\infty} \frac{\sin u}{u^{\sigma / k}} d u=\frac{1}{k} \int_{0}^{1} \frac{\sin u}{u^{\sigma / k}} d u+\frac{1}{k} \int_{1}^{\infty} \frac{\sin u}{u^{\sigma / k}} d u
\]

\(\int_{1}^{\infty} \frac{\sin u}{u^{\sigma / k}} d u\) has ROAC \(\operatorname{Re} s>k\) and ROC \(\operatorname{Re} s>0\)
As \(u \downarrow 0, \frac{\sin u}{u^{\sigma / k}} \sim u^{1-\sigma / k}\), so \(\int_{0}^{1} \frac{\sin u}{u^{\sigma / k}} d u\) has ROAC \(\operatorname{Re} s<2 k\)
Thus \(\mathcal{L}\{x\}\) has \(\operatorname{ROC} k<\operatorname{Re} s<2 k\) and \(\operatorname{ROC} 0<\operatorname{Re} s<2 k\).
\(x^{\prime}(t)=k e^{k t} \sin \left(e^{k t}\right)+k e^{2 k t} \cos \left(e^{k t}\right)\). 对于\(s=\sigma \in \mathbb{R}\),

\[
\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} x^{\prime}(t) e^{-s t} d t=\int_{0}^{\infty} \frac{\sin u+u \cos u}{u^{\sigma / k}} d u
\]
\(\mathcal{L}\left\{x^{\prime}\right\}\) has empty ROAC, and ROC \(k<\operatorname{Re} s<2 k\)

Note \(\lim _{t \rightarrow \pm \infty} x(t) e^{-s t}=0\) fails for \(s\) with \(0<\operatorname{Re} s<k\)

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
时域微分性质
如果\(x(t)=O\left(e^{a t}\right)\) as \(t \rightarrow+\infty\) and \(x(t)=O\left(e^{b t}\right)\) as \(t \rightarrow-\infty\), 则
\[
x(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} X(s), \quad \text { with ROAC containing } a<\operatorname{Re} s<b
\]
and
\[
\frac{d}{d t} x(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} s X(s), \quad \text { with ROC containing } a<\operatorname{Re} s<b
\]
注意： 一般而言， from the absolute convergence of \(\mathcal{L}\{x\}\) at \(s=s_{0}\) we can only conclude the convergence of \(\mathcal{L}\left\{x^{\prime}\right\}\) at \(s=s_{0}\).
注意： We mostly deal with \(x(t)\) of the form \(\sum_{k=0}^{m} p_{k}(t) e^{\alpha_{k} t} u\left( \pm t+\beta_{k}\right)\), 其中 \(p_{k}\) are polynomials. After introducing Laplace transform for singularity functions, we have for such functions,
\[
\frac{d^{n}}{d t^{n}} x(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} s^{n} X(s), \quad \text { with ROC containing } a<\operatorname{Re} s<b
\]

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
\(s\) 域微分性质
If
\[
x(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} X(s), \quad \operatorname{ROAC} \sigma_{1}<\operatorname{Re} s<\sigma_{2}
\]
则
\[
-t x(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{d}{d s} X(s), \quad \operatorname{ROAC} \sigma_{1}<\operatorname{Re} s<\sigma_{2}
\]
“证明”. Differentiating under integral sign (can be justified)
\[
\frac{d}{d s} \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} x(t) e^{-s t} d t=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} x(t) \frac{d}{d s} e^{-s t} d t=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}-t x(t) e^{-s t} d t
\]
例.
\[
e^{-a t} u(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{1}{s+a}, \quad \operatorname{Re} s>-a
\]
\[
t^{n} e^{-a t} u(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow}\left(-\frac{d}{d s}\right)^{n} \frac{1}{s+a}=\frac{n!}{(s+a)^{n+1}}, \quad \operatorname{Re} s>-a
\]
Similarly,
\[
-t^{n} e^{-a t} u(-t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{n!}{(s+a)^{n+1}}, \quad \operatorname{Re} s<-a
\]

title: EL331 信号与系统 · 第30讲（中文版）
text:
时域积分性质
If
\[
x(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} X(s), \quad \text { ROAC }=R
\]
则
\[
\int_{-\infty}^{t} x(\tau) d \tau \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{1}{s} X(s), \quad \text { ROAC } \supset R \cap\{\operatorname{Re} s>0\}
\]
证明. Follows from convolution property and the following
\[
\int_{-\infty}^{t} x(\tau) d \tau=(x * u)(t)
\]
and
\[
u(t) \stackrel{\mathcal{L}}{\longleftrightarrow} \frac{1}{s} \text { with ROAC }=\{\operatorname{Re} s>0\}
\]
注意： Th为 property holds also for Laplace transforms of singularity functions and will be useful computing some Laplace transforms.
